body:
Ronny Jackson talked to the Oath Keepers on Jan 6 | |
---
| | | [ ](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=da25532118&e=4712f71bea)
---
| Friends,

Things are getting serious.

New information shows the **[Oath Keepers](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=609b0710b2&e=4712f71bea)** \- the far-right militia that participated in January 6th - sought to "protect" my opponent, Ronny Jackson, that day because he apparently had "critical data."

**Here are a series of text messages, as reported in the[ Texas Tribune](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=e9f0bca1fc&e=4712f71bea):** _“Dr. Ronnie Jackson - on the move. Needs protection. If anyone inside cover him,” a person texted at 3:08 p.m. and included a photo that could not be seen from the court documents._ _“He has critical data to protect,” the person added._ _At 3:10, Stewart Rhodes, the founder and leader of the Oath Keepers, responded to the text citing Jackson and instructed a person to “Give him my cell.”_ _**I have so many questions.**_
* What "data" did Ronny Jackson have?
* What was it to be used for?
* Did Ronny call Stewart Rhodes?
* Did Ronny make contact with any Oath Keeper that day?
* What role did the Oath Keepers expect Ronny Jackson to play in overturning the election?

**And finally: **

[**Was Ronny Jackson actively working to overturn the results of a legitimate, free, and fair American election?**](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=b20573df65&e=4712f71bea)

[_**I'm disgusted.**_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=96649c78b2&e=4712f71bea)

It doesn't look good for Ronny. [He doesn't deserve to be in Congress. ](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=afb9327e97&e=4712f71bea)

**I know I've asked before, but it's time to go big:[Can you donate $25 or more to my campaign? ](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=09dc77ec57&e=4712f71bea)**

Thank you,
Kathleen.

Dear Patriot,

No one man has forced Congress to address immigration reform and border security more than Jim Gilchrist. In 2004, he sent out one email (before there was Facebook or even an iPhone) to his friends that spread across our nation like wildfire, eventually resulting in thousands of volunteers coming to the Mexican American border in lawn chairs, binoculars, and satellite phones. They stood watch on our border (the world’s largest neighborhood watch program) and called the woefully undermanned US Border Patrol when they saw people crossing our border.

The Minuteman Project had begun, and Jim Gilchrist was its founder. I am so proud to earn his endorsement today.

Sincerely,

Tim Aalders

* * *

**Minuteman Project Founder Jim Gilchrist**
_News Release
For Immediate Release
April 19, 2022
Media contact: JimGilchrist@MinutemanProject.com_
### Minuteman Founder Endorses Tim Aalders for US Congress
##### Gilchrist reminds voters John Curtis sponsored amnesty bill for 11.5 million illegals just 2 months ago

Aliso Viejo, CA – Minuteman Project Founder and President Jim Gilchrist, the nation's leading grassroots activist on the issue of immigration reform and border security, announced he is endorsing Tim Aalders in the Republican Primary in Utah’s Third Congressional District. Gilchrist cited Aalders’s strong stand never supporting amnesty, eliminating Sanctuary Cities, and building a wall that will secure our borders with Mexico. Polls show that immigration reform and border security remains one of the top issues facing voters of the state of Utah in the upcoming April 23 GOP Convention.

Gilchrist stated, “While the Democrat Mayor of Provo, Utah, John Curtis ran a Sanctuary City and ignored Federal Law and support of Federal Law Enforcement Officers, Tim Aalders was exposing career politicians like Curtis and their refusal to follow the law. As Congressman John Curtis actually cosponsored two bills that granted amnesty to illegal farm workers and expanded low-skilled illegal immigration.”

Gilchrist continued, “Curtis even sponsored a bill that would grant amnesty to approximately 2.9 million illegal aliens who came to the U.S. under the age of 19, grant amnesty to approximately 500,000 aliens who were granted Temporary Protected Status, would grant amnesty to approximately 2.5 million illegal alien farm workers, and create an amnesty program for the remaining 5.6 million illegal aliens. That is amnesty for at least 11.5 million illegal aliens.”

Regarding the Utah Republican Primary Gilchrist said, “Unlike John Curtis, Tim Aalders will demand both the Federal and State Government to enforce our laws and our borders. Aalders truly has a committed stand on the issues of immigration reform and border security and is just the leader Utah needs to end the chaos of illegal immigration.”

Said Aalders, “I am very proud to have received the endorsement of Jim Gilchrist today. My long track record of never supporting amnesty, demanding that we eliminate Sanctuary Cities, and building something along our border that will secure our borders with Mexico is resolute.”

Aalders further stated, “Jim is right about John Curtis. He is a Democrat. He was elected as a Democrat. He votes like a Democrat. Republicans across Utah will be looking for a conservative to vote to be their next US Congressman, and I want them to choose the only conservative Republican on the ballot who can win – Tim Aalders.”

Jim Gilchrist founded the multi-ethnic Minuteman Project on Oct. 1, 2004, after years of frustrated efforts trying to get a neglectful U.S. government to simply enforce existing immigration laws. He was one of the original campaign endorsers of President Trump in the summer of 2015. -30-
* * *
Jim Gilchrist is the founder and President of the Minuteman Project, a multi-ethnic grassroots organization dedicated to border security and immigration reform. For more information see www.MinutemanProject.com

##
19 April 22

**Only 13 Weeks Until The July 19 Primary.**
Although Jeff has two primary competitors, they are not campaigning or fundraising, yet we will not take anything for granted and we are actively and tirelessly campaigning...And We Need Your Help! The options are easy!

**In Person Meet & Greet**
The campaign covered over 500 homes last week reaching Primary Voters in Beltsville & Burtonsville.
A Meet & Greet is scheduled for THIS Thursday, 7-8p at The Green Turtle in Burtonsville.
15660 Old Columbia Pike, 20866.
This is a great opportunity to learn more about our winning strategy and how to get involved.
Invite others to attend, to meet and hear from Jeff!

**Sign Waving - One Power Hour**
THIS, Saturday, April 23, you're invited to sign wave for one power hour with the Jeff Warner For Congress campaign.
Noon-1p
East-West Hwy (Rt 410) & Baltimore Ave. (Route 1)
You should be able to park at McDonalds (6228 Baltimore Ave, Riverdale Park, MD 20737)
Please park as far as possible from the building so we don't limit customer access.
Let's meet at the intersection of East-West Hwy (Rt 410) & Route 1
You should see Jeff there.

If you have a sign, please bring it. If you have a sign and are not planning on sign waving or posting, please let us know so we can put it to use and stretch our limited funds. Consider dressing layers and bring your BIG smile.
.
**Phone Calling**
A BIG THANK YOU, to everyone who is calling! We're making GREAT progress.

Please keep in mind, around 2% of calls, involve speaking with voters. The goal is to introduce the campaign through a pre-recorded message from Jeff Warner to the voter's voicemail which appears to be a personal call from their next Congressman, Jeff Warner.

You can make an impact no matter where you live in the nation. Please email the campaign at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com if you’re in interested in getting trained in order to receive the training info. It's easy.

**Important Details:**
Phone calls are audio only, no video.
A sample script is provided.
The system is all online. Anyone in the USA can assist.
Serve from home (or anyplace you'd like). There is no call center.
Your phone and phone number are not used and are therefore protected.
You choose how much you'd like to call.

**Social Media**
The campaign is taking steps to build Jeff Warner's social media presence.
You can find Jeff under RepJeffWarner on Facebook & Twitter.
Be sure to like, share, subscribe, follow, etc. to help us grow his following.

One of Jeff Warner's opponents in the General Election in November dropped out this week. This is more good news for the campaign.

Thank You for your support. The campaign continues to make and break records. Come and be a part of this amazing team. Imagine how good it will be to say you were part of this team in November as we celebrate our historic victory!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=39de474707&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

name: Gisele Barreto Fetterman
subject: The “Pothead” Second Lady
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I’m a medicinal marijuana patient, and I want to share my personal story.
#
Hey, Derek — it’s Gisele!
[**_Before I humbly ask you to pitch in your first $5 donation to our campaign_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47385?refcode=em20220419-5454&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5454%2E434096%2EGP3mEf), I want to share a personal story:
**My experience as a medicinal marijuana patient.**
John and I are deeply dedicated to the fight for full cannabis legalization. Legal cannabis has changed my life, and I know it can help so many others too. I hope my story of being helped by the plant can help other people understand it rather than fear it.
I’ve lived with chronic back pain most of my life. Every photo I have leading up to my medical marijuana license has one thing in common, a memory of pain.
I was always fearful of strong prescription medications like opioids. As I got older, I tried countless different combinations to manage my pain: Chiropractic care, yoga, a million types of stretches. They each helped, but there was no long-term fix.
Then, in 2016, Pennsylvania legalized marijuana for medical use. I was one of the first people in line when the first dispensary opened. Today, legal cannabis is the medicine that keeps me pain-free.
**The prejudice and misinformation surrounding this plant is one of the biggest hurdles to legalization, Derek.** I’m regularly referred to as the “Pothead” Second Lady. I’ve even had folks tell me, “You don’t look like a medical marijuana user.”
After I was included in an issue of Weed World, people even sent me D.A.R.E. resources. At least it helped my childhood friends dig up this photo of me in 5th grade. Not trying to brag but... art contest winner! 😆
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47385?refcode=em20220419-5454&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5454%2E434096%2EGP3mEf)
John and I have been pushing hard for the full legalization of Cannabis in Pennsylvania. In 2019, John embarked on an adult-use cannabis listening tour in all 67 PA counties. In three months, the historic tour saw over 10,000 people turn out in person.
**Cannabis should be legal, safe, and pure for medicinal and recreational use by adults in Pennsylvania and everywhere in the U.S.** Legal cannabis will create tens of thousands of new jobs. It will help farmers, veterans, and people suffering from chronic pain. It will help us expunge all the senseless marijuana convictions. And it will be a big step forward toward racial justice.
Also, let the people grow 🌱
**[Derek, will you please make your very first donation of $5 to help John keep fighting for legal weed? My husband, John Fetterman, will be the strongest and loudest supporter of legal weed that the Senate has ever seen. Any amount you’re able to give, even $4.20😉, makes a huge impact. ](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47385?refcode=em20220419-5454&t=3&akid=5454%2E434096%2EGP3mEf)**
**[Contribute »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47385?amount=5&refcode=em20220419-5454&t=22&akid=5454%2E434096%2EGP3mEf)**
Thank you for reading today, and thank you for your support.
With love,
Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
SLOP
Second Lady of Pennsylvania

Then, in 2016, Pennsylvania legalized marijuana for medical use. I was one of the first people in line when the first dispensary opened. Today, legal cannabis is the medicine that keeps me pain-free. The prejudice and misinformation surrounding this plant is one of the biggest hurdles to legalization, Derek. I’m regularly referred to as the “Pothead” Second Lady. I’ve even had folks tell me, “You don’t look like a medical marijuana user.” After I was included in an issue of Weed World, people even sent me D.A.R.E. resources. At least it helped my childhood friends dig up this photo of me in 5th grade. Not trying to brag but... art contest winner! 😆 John and I have been pushing hard for the full legalization of Cannabis in Pennsylvania. In 2019, John embarked on an adult-use cannabis listening tour in all 67 PA counties. In three months, the historic tour saw over 10,000 people turn out in person. Cannabis should be legal, safe, and pure for medicinal and recreational use by adults in Pennsylvania and everywhere in the U.S. Legal cannabis will create tens of thousands of new jobs. It will help farmers, veterans, and people suffering from chronic pain. It will help us expunge all the senseless marijuana convictions. And it will be a big step forward toward racial justice. Also, let the people grow 🌱 Thank you for reading today, and thank you for your support. With love, Gisele ❤️ Gisele Barreto Fetterman SLOP Second Lady of Pennsylvania | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

Fellow Conservative:

Senate Conservatives Fund is proud to endorse State Attorney General Eric Schmitt for the U.S. Senate in Missouri.
Eric is a tough, principled constitutional conservative who has fought for the rights of individuals against anti-American, anti-family elites colluding against them. During his tenure as Missouri's Attorney General, Schmitt has been everywhere.
✓ When Democrats manipulated 2020 election rules, Schmitt leaped into the fray, leading other state attorneys general to support election integrity lawsuits in Pennsylvania and Texas.
✓ When school boards tried to force students to wear masks against their parents' objections, Schmitt took them to court on behalf of kids, families, and true science.
✓ When Big Tech firms colluded to cancel conservatives from their platforms, Schmitt launched one of the nation's most extensive investigations into their discriminatory business practices.

Please join us by making a generous contribution to his grassroots campaign today!
✓ When woke activists attacked a Missouri high school football coach for leading his players in prayer before a game, Schmitt defended the coach and made clear to school officials that he did nothing wrong under the law or the Constitution.
✓ Schmitt was also the first Attorney General to sue the Chinese Communist Party and the Wuhan Institute of Virology for their criminal negligence, coverups, and lies stemming from the origins of the Covid-19 pandemic.
These were all fights of choice by Eric Schmitt. He didn't have to wage them, and there were plenty of reasons not to. Big donors and the media don't like culture warriors, don't like holding leftists accountable. But Eric Schmitt doesn't work for them - he works for the
people. As Attorney General, he put Missouri families first. And in the Senate, he will put America first.
Please help send Eric Schmitt to the U.S. Senate.
The most important job for senators in 2023 won't be passing bills - not with Joe Biden in the White House for two more years. No, it will be investigations - subpoenaing documents, deposing witnesses, finding whistleblowers, and holding hearings. And we need a fighter like
Eric Schmitt to do it.
For all Biden's scandals, there's much we still don't know about:
▶︎ Hunter Biden's shady business dealings.▶︎ The border crisis and the location of illegal immigrants.▶︎ Anthony Fauci's role in the development of Covid-19.▶︎ The FBI's targeting of parents as "domestic terrorists."▶︎ White House collusion with Big

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zamkotrl53nu6ng7vucu0s0rblmm26fu3ek0hmp8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0c5im0or2cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8c3jckqn8dhk61rj0tjm61gb9p1ie4qncttncop6ctdj6aq7dcjim6pbdd34s1jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coorecr2c1p30phh62pmcdtgmlin49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7hff446kh9c66d2r0f5bursqtukmgo4uuat0i4g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0c5im0or2cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjbf938c7sf29f086taf7971s2gfi4djuhvtoedg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0c5im0or2cph2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. body:
The Right Thing At The Wrong Time Is The Wrong Thing So many of us seek of the will of God for our lives with tremendous passion. This is a good thin
| | |
---
## The Right Thing At The Wrong Time Is The Wrong Thing
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7312116.5382.1.b3791b3aae8cd4f879047bda9d8c88fc)
---
So many of us seek of the **will of God** for our lives with tremendous passion. This is a good thing but sometimes we forget to seek the **timing of God** as well.
Paul says in **1st Corinthians 9:24** , _“Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.”_
In order to **run your race** (live out _God's call_ on your life), you need the **right tempo** aka _timing_.
We all face the dilemma of **waiting**. I've discovered that **the greater the blessing that God has for us the greater the patience He requires of us**.
We have to recognize that a _promise delayed_ is not a _promise cancelled_.
This is very difficult in our world because we live in a microwave society.
We value quickness over quality.
It's been said by Chuck Swindoll, _"If greed is the demon of money, lust the demon of sex and pride the demon of power then speed is the demon of spiritual depth.”_
The Kingdom of God is not like a microwave but more like an oven. **Quality is greater than quickness.**
Before God can ever do something great through us, He must first do something great in us.
Too often we get tired of waiting and take things into our own hands much like Moses.
**Acts 7:20-27** says, _“At that time Moses was born, and he was no ordinary child. For three months he was cared for by his family.21 When he was placed outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son. 22 Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action. 23 “When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his own people, the Israelites. 24 He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his defense and avenged him by killing the Egyptian. 25 Moses thought that his own people would realize that God was using him to rescue them, but they did not. 26 The next day Moses came upon two Israelites who were fighting. He tried to reconcile them by saying, ‘Men, you are brothers; why do you want to hurt each other?’ 27 “But the man who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us? 28 Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’ 29 When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he settled as a foreigner and had two sons.”_
This passage sums up first 40 years of the life of Moses.
He was _called_ to deliver God's people out of Egypt.
Moses was trained in all the wisdom of Egypt, which was the most sophisticated society in the Ancient Near East. It was home to the **Temple of the Sun** that was the equivalent to Oxford today. It was there that Moses was trained in different languages, arts and military strategies.
Moses was **mighty in word and deed** and was being prepared for the throne in Egypt.
However, Moses knew he was not called to be a Pharaoh but to deliver God's people from Pharaoh.
**He knew the will of God but not the timing of God.**
Moses tried to force the will of God through when he came up with a plan to spark the Exodus; he killed an Egyptian taskmaster and it backfired. It wasn't God's timing.
What is interesting is the way that **Exodus 2:12** describes what happened: _“Looking this way and that and seeing no one, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.”_
Moses got an idea and looked to his left and to his right but he never looked up.
He launched a **premature strike** which resulted in a 40-year setback of him hiding in the desert.
It was the right thing at the wrong time.
Moses was passionate about God's will but not God's timing.
Thankfully God didn't give up on Moses. After being in the desert for 40 years God appeared to Moses at a burning bush and told him the timing had come to lead the great Exodus out of Egypt.
I want to encourage you to **not only seek the will of God but also the timing of God** in your life.

Hello,
As bombs began raining down on Ukrainian cities, Donald Trump called into Fox News to blame – you guessed it – Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton.
As Russian tanks began pouring over the Ukrainian border, Fox News host Laura Ingraham had the gall to call Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky “pathetic.”
And if you tune into Tucker Carlson these days, you’ll see a show that might as well have been written and produced by Russian state media. **Fox News showcases the chasm between traditional GOP normative behavior and the fringe-right cabal now headed by Donald J. Trump.**
As the commander of military forces in East Africa, I asked the American Forces Network to replace Fox News during meal hours for troops. Why? Because they were harmful to America's outreach overseas. They put our troops in jeopardy and made my job harder. Today, they have accomplices.
Without Fox News, Trump would have only ever been a bungling celebrity who foolishly and laughably ran for president.
Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. **My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.**
If I defeat Chuck Grassely and turn Iowa blue this November, I will be the most senior military person ever elected to the United States Senate. And I think it’s about time we had more people in leadership who understand the true costs of war and media manipulation of facts, commonly called disinformation.
**The polls show we can win.** The pundits say we must win. And with your help today, we can fight back against McConnell’s Super PAC lies and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate.

They teach young people that slavery--not freedom--is and always will be the central and defining idea of the American experience, making our country irredeemable. This project has garnered universal acclaim from the news media. In fact, the lead essayist just won a Pulitzer Prize! There are even talks about making the “1619 Project” into a feature film. **Given popular and widespread efforts like these, we should not be surprised that there is a decreasing sense of patriotism among younger Americans --and an increasing tendency to embrace socialism and other liberty-destroying ideas.** Education has become a battleground, and reviving a proper understanding of American history and government, especially among younger citizens, must be our** _most urgent priority._** Hillsdale College is at the forefront of this effort. **We are actively engaging the Left on the battlefield of education. And I need your help to make this effort even more effective.** Hillsdale is America’s most powerful advocate for intelligent and informed patriotism--our best defense against the loss of our liberty and insidious beliefs like socialism. We do this on our Michigan campus, with an undergraduate and graduate student body of over 1,500, and through education that reaches and teaches millions of citizens each year on behalf of liberty. And in response to new efforts such as the media-driven “1619 Project” that seek to turn the next generation of citizens against the principles of the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution, Hillsdale must expand this critical work--especially in 2020. As I said before, to fight and win this battle, Hillsdale needs your help right away. The FIRST step I need you to take right now is to complete the **RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey**. This national project seeks to make it clear that people in your state and nationwide still revere our founding principles of liberty, and refuse to let them be corrupted by those who hold America in contempt. **As _The New York Times’_ efforts make clear, powerful forces vehemently oppose this view of America, and their assault on our glorious history is taking place before our very eyes. ** _Our ongoing response, rooted in genuine learning, and proven to reach millions of citizens, must be escalated as quickly as possible._ And if, upon completing your Battle Plan, you feel a strong connection to Hillsdale’s work, then I urge you to please consider including a generous tax-deductible gift in support of expanding these efforts on behalf of liberty. And unlike most colleges and universities that rely on federal funding and subsidies, EVERY PENNY of funding for Hillsdale’s educational outreach comes from the voluntary support of intelligent patriots like you. This is because Hillsdale College refuses EVEN ONE PENNY of state or federal taxpayer funding--even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. That’s so important, I need to say it again--Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding! **In this way, Hillsdale remains truly independent, avoiding unconstitutional regulations that would violate the College’s educational mission.** Hillsdale has built national support from hundreds of thousands of citizens. These intelligent patriots know that liberty in America is in trouble thanks to progressive control of our schools and institutions. And these citizens are determined to preserve our liberty--as I believe you are. These supporters give what they can, when they can--gifts of $25 or $50 or more, sometimes much more ... because they understand that every dollar given goes to reaching and teaching millions of people--including our nation’s youth--with genuine learning about liberty and the Constitution. Here are the key aspects of Hillsdale’s plan for your review and feedback: **BATTLE PLAN POINT #1: Identify the Critical Concerns of Everyday Americans** I mentioned that our network of supporters that is hundreds of thousands of patriots strong--such a broad base of support gives us invaluable public-opinion data on what Americans are MOST concerned about given the current state of our nation. We are always eager to add new perspectives (like yours) that can make our work the most relevant and timely possible. **Your participation today will allow Hillsdale to strengthen our educational outreach efforts by targeting them where they’re needed most, on the areas of concern that matter most to the American people.** You were selected to be part of this effort based on your record of involvement in causes that strengthen America, AND because of Hillsdale’s confidence that you will respond quickly and honestly, lending your voice to our efforts to restore the Constitution. I’m counting on and very much looking forward to your survey response! **BATTLE PLAN POINT #2: Counter Progressive Teaching in America’s Schools** In this section we dig deep into Hillsdale’s proven educational outreach, and give you a sense of how we lead important conversations surrounding America’s history and founding principles--AND ask what YOU think about these efforts. And make no mistake--Hillsdale is uniquely qualified to drive this effort. Did you know that Hillsdale is one of only a few American colleges and universities that requires each student, regardless of major, to complete a one-semester course on the Constitution? This fact has earned the support of so many Americans who did not attend the College, and who have never even set foot on our campus--they understand that what we teach in our classrooms radiates all over America. Is this important to you? In 2012, Hillsdale began offering online courses _free of charge_ , because we see it as an effective way promote intelligent patriotism and civic virtue. We market the courses on social media and online to reach large audiences, especially younger Americans. The response has been tremendous--over 2.3 million citizens have taken one or more of our online courses. Do you think this is an effective means of reaching and teaching millions of Americans on behalf of liberty? We even have an online course that directly counters _The New York Times’_ “1619 Project.” This free course is called **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** and presents an unbiased and complete account of America’s past. To me this is a great example of why these free courses are needed: They safeguard the country, through education, against the damage to liberty inflicted by the Left. And what do you think about sending a free monthly digest of liberty, to millions of people? This newsletter is called _Imprimis_ , and it features speeches delivered at Hillsdale events by prominent scholars, journalists, and policymakers, focused on political, economic, historic, and cultural topics from a constitutional viewpoint. _Imprimis_ is America’s most widely-circulated publication in support of liberty, reaching more households and businesses than either the _Wall Street Journal_ or the “fake news” _New York Times_. Issues covering topics such as “Rediscovering the Wisdom of American History” and “Shall We Defend our Common History?” set _Imprimis_ apart. The publication is as a powerful counterbalance to the biased media outlets that pursue narrow, ideologically driven distortions of history. (If you’re not yet an _Imprimis_ subscriber, we’ll be happy to sign you up as soon as we hear from you.) **BATTLE PLAN POINT #3: Restore Excellence to K-12 Schools** In this section we explore how Hillsdale College is reshaping American K-12 education, especially through our Barney Charter School Initiative, which helps launch and guide classical K-12 charter schools nationwide, teaching thousands of K-12 students. These schools all have a strong civics curriculum. The curriculum provides young Americans with a solid grounding in our nation’s history, our limited constitutional government, and economics. In doing so, Hillsdale provides communities with a practical model of how schools can best serve students and the country. **Sustained by our supporters, Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative has assisted in the founding of more than 20 classical K-12 charter schools in 11 states, with approximately 12,000 students enrolled. And more of these K-12 schools are opening each year.** Do you support this effort to set a new standard for K-12 education and give young Americans a proper education? Hillsdale also launched a new initiative to send pocket Constitutions to thousands of elementary and junior high schools. We ship them with a promise to send as many pocket Constitutions as their schools need. **The response has been astounding.** We’ve now sent out more than 500,000 pocket Constitutions across the country, and we receive more requests every week. Does this effort to restore the Constitution to K-12 schools sound like a good idea to you? As you select your answers, I believe you will find that Hillsdale’s educational outreach is a powerful way to confront and ultimately overcome the progressive forces that seek to instill in young people the ruinous idea that America stands for slavery, not freedom. I know you love this country, and I hope you will partner with Hillsdale in defending America through education--education aimed at citizens of all ages nationwide. The first step is getting your thoughts on our **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60794%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JrQcMvgbMwI5gzaB3%2fRajQ&sysid=1)**
With your response you will represent your state as part of a major sampling of citizen opinion that can help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views and concerns of mainstream Americans--views that we can make available to policymakers and opinion leaders when we discuss the Left’s agenda, and use to strengthen our educational outreach efforts. What Hillsdale needs now is YOU--your thoughtful input on the work we’re doing, and your generous support to expand our work. **So please complete the[Battle Plan Survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60705%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=426oT%2bqtN8z3Za3XI5R3DQ&sysid=1) today.** When you give to Hillsdale and share your opinions, you will join a dedicated and growing team of intelligent patriots, who always step up when the time comes to defend America against the progressives’ attack on American history and liberty. Thank you for your commitment to liberty in America. Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Assoc. Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 **P.S**. We are in a battle for the future of America, because the Left is determined to transform our country ... by fundamentally changing how history is taught to young people. Education is the battlefield, and Hillsdale College urgently needs you standing with us to support and sustain our efforts. With your help, we can continue to reach and teach millions of citizens of all ages, especially the youngest Americans, with the principles of liberty underlying the Constitution. Please complete **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60706%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DApfiAHGroE0hdutCDqeAQ&sysid=1)** to shape Hillsdale College’s defense of America against the progressive assault on history. Your response is needed within five days so we can finalize plans to expand our educational outreach on behalf of liberty.

body:
Peter,

It’s 4/20! And you know what that means: it’s time to talk about legalizing marijuana in Florida.

I’ve been consistent on this issue for my entire career. I’ve been a tireless advocate for marijuana legalization for years, and as Florida’s Commissioner of Agriculture, I pushed to legalize hemp and fought back against restrictions on Florida’s medical marijuana program.

Meanwhile, Charlie Crist (as Florida’s Republican Governor) implemented harsh marijuana sentencing laws, sending thousands of Floridians to jail for nonviolent crimes. And don’t even get me started on the harm DeSantis has done to our fight for just, equitable, and fair drug laws.

As your next Governor, I’ll reverse the damage Crist and DeSantis have done. I’ll fight to expunge past marijuana convictions and make our dream of legal marijuana a reality. And I’ll do it all with help from supporters like you, Peter.

If you’re with me in the fight to legalize marijuana for adult use, 4/20 is the perfect day to show your support. Click here to chip in $4.20 to help us win this race. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-apr-2022?refcode=420_1]

body:
This fight isn't about me, it's about our children and the future of the nation.
To view this email as a web page, go [here.](https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=9ca0042f27f837323567bb433d9c087743c6b1dfd607f7046a1806052632982cdc04b56982b4c0cee252a414511171cf1dd34e3572ac7edc7d4fbe9e6403173441857e1fb01f69711e63b184b18a4915)

Peter, I will never allow woke corporations to strong-arm our state.

Yesterday, I announced that I am calling on the state legislature to eliminate Disney's sweetheart deal - negotiated and preserved for decades by the powerful. This deal allows Disney to govern itself on the grounds of Walt Disney World - a benefit not afforded to you or me.

**If Disney wants to pick a fight,_they chose the wrong guy._**_ _

As Governor, I was elected to put the people of Florida first, and I will not allow a woke corporation based in California to run our state.

Disney has gotten away with special deals from the state of Florida for way too long. It took a look under the hood to see what Disney has become to truly understand their inappropriate influence.

Disney thought they ruled Florida. They even tried to attack me to advance their woke agenda. Now, parents see Disney for what it is. **And now is the time to put the power back in the hands of Floridians and out of the pockets of woke executives.**

Disney and other woke corporations won't get away with peddling their unchecked pressure campaigns any longer. If we want to keep the Democrat machine and their corporate lapdogs accountable, we have to stand together now.

They are coming for your rights and we must stop them. **[Join in the fight against the Democrat machine and woke Disney executives. Friend,
18 states have successfully **legalized recreational cannabis, and 39 allow medical cannabis** , but cannabis is still **illegal at the federal level**. This 4/20, we must call on President Biden to finally legalize cannabis at the federal level and expunge past records.
As much as we love to see progress in the cannabis community, communities of color still disproportionately face barriers to opportunity caused by cannabis-related arrests and convictions. **We need to put an end to the injustice of cannabis-related incarcerations**.
There is still much work to do in order to rectify the many decades of racist policies that target communities of color throughout the nation.
[Take action: Tell Biden to legalize cannabis at the federal level and expunge the records of cannabis-related arrests.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44328811/341145232/-636555530?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOGJhMTUzZC1iMmMwLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qne7qmO7FQBYBmCs4AVRrdZCn1NI79S3zxqrpYMFhYg=&emci=08d6f0e6-3dbf-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8ba153d-b2c0-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172)

| DIEHL-ALLEN TICKET RECEIVES ENDORSEMENT FROM TOBY LEARY OF HYANNIS-BASED CAPE GUN WORKS Toby Leary, the well-known owner of Cape Gun Works in Hyannis, announced today that he is endorsing Geoff Diehl and Leah Cole Allen for Governor and Lieutenant Governor. "I've known Geoff Diehl for a long time, and I know he is a solid supporter of Second Amendment rights. So is Leah Cole Allen," Leary said in a statement. "Geoff and Leah understand that firearms ownership is not just a fundamental Constitutional right, but also important in support of self-defense and as a recreational hobby for many Massachusetts residents. They also know that owning a firearm carries with it certain responsibility, including proper education, training, and safe equipment. I am convinced that Geoff Diehl and Leah Cole Allen are the best candidates to defend these rights and principles as our next Governor and Lieutenant Governor, and I am proud to endorse them." "Toby Leary is a well-known business owner and a legend in the firearms dealership community, and I sincerely appreciate his endorsement," Diehl said. "Gun owners throughout New England know and respect Toby for all he's given to the firearms industry and its customers. I've had the privilege of visiting Cape Gun Works, and I appreciate the hard work Toby has put into building up his business over the years. I'm proud to represent the Second Amendment rights and interests of Massachusetts gun owners as a candidate for Governor." "As someone who's committed to protecting the Second Amendment, I greatly appreciate Toby Leary's endorsement," said Leah Cole Allen. "I respect Toby as a leader in the firearms dealership industry and all of the hard work he has done on behalf of gun owners. I am thankful to have his support of my candidacy for Lieutenant Governor." Diehl, a resident of Whitman, formerly served as a State Representative and supported Second Amendment rights and responsible gun ownership as a member of the Legislature. As a legislator, Diehl was credited by the Massachusetts-based Gun Owners' Action League with a 100% rating for his positions on firearms issues from 2014-2015 and again from 2016-2017. He also defended these principles as the Republican candidate for the U.S. Senate in 2018. Leah Cole Allen likewise supported Second Amendment rights as a member of the Legislature and was a vocal advocate for gun owners. Both have made support for Constitutional rights of Massachusetts citizens, including support for the Second Amendment, a cornerstone of their candidacies. Toby Leary is the president and co-founder of Cape Gun Works in Hyannis, Mass. Leary was first introduced to shooting at the age of 12 through the Boy Scouts of America, and he has turned his life-long love for firearms, self defense, and the Second Amendment into a successful business. Since its opening in 2012, Cape Gun Works has been well-known throughout New England for its high standards and its commitment to providing both citizens and law enforcement personnel with a place to be trained, equipped, and educated for firearms ownership in a safe, clean, and professional environment. For more information about Geoff Diehl and his campaign for Governor, please visit www.GeoffDiehl.com. For more information about Leah Cole Allen and her campaign, please visit www.leahcoleallen.com.

body:
The comments, stories, and insights we’ve received from Republicans, Democrats, and Independents nationwide clearly show we're not alone in our disgust.
|
---
Hi Friend, A couple days ago, I sent out an email asking you to vent about the state of today’s GOP. We’ve been so moved by the feedback we’ve gotten from so many of you. The comments, stories, and insight we’ve received from Republicans, Democrats, and Independents nationwide is a powerful testament to what she and I believe: Americans are fed up with the Republican Party’s extremism, January 6 lies, and COVID denial. And together, we can defend our democracy from this dangerous political force. I wanted to share some of the feedback we’ve gotten from you: _“I left the Republican party because of Donald Trump, particularly because of his claims of election fraud. . . though I am blind, with mild cerebral palsy in my legs, my mind is sharp. Trump’s apparent mockery of a disabled reporter was a major reason I began to have second thoughts about the GOP.” —Brian_ _“Someone needs to stand up for those of us who, while being Republicans, believe what happened over the last 4 years was some of the worst of American history, by one of the worst presidents in American history.” — Mary_ _“There are some Republicans I know who are decent, who refuse to accept the former president’s alternate reality, like Liz Cheney and Adam Kinzinger. I wish more Republicans would speak up. The far-right wing of the GOP is out of control.”— Janet_ _“I am a proud Democrat and stand with you. It is our country and our flag . . . not yours or mine.” —Jose_ If you haven’t left a comment of your own, please share your thoughts by replying to our emails. These messages are so important for us as we prepare for all the battles to come, and our staff reads each and every one of them. Your comments keep us going as we build our movement to defend democracy. Sarah Longwell Executive Director, Republican Accountability Project

It’s been an incredible year meeting Marylanders, finding new favorite spots up and down and across the state, and building a history-making coalition for progressive change. And we couldn’t have done it without your support. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44334254/341169302/1974957641?source=email-ngp-20220420-b1_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220420-b1_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220420&&&&utm_content=b1_fr_full&&&&utm_term=JK_S1_C1&&&&amount=25&refcode2=d74f3d07-bcc0-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNzRmM2QwNy1iY2MwLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=djXNKSD1cnMnzT37JgMktRaF9tjdGlPGViDO8x8-9Ds=) This past year has been one of the greatest in my life, and I have been so humbled by all of the support that we have received. Just 10,033 votes (0.2 percentage points) decided Florida's last Senate race – so I'll tell you the plain truth: **I cannot win this without you.** [**That's why I'm asking you to become one of the donors to my campaign for Senate by splitting a contribution between me and Serve America right now. Every dollar you can spare will help us build the strongest grassroots operation to defeat Rubio, flip Florida blue and defend our Senate majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44334670/341171110/-74008005?refcode=20220420_Demings&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzczNGE4Zi1iZGMwLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YBLpJSiWrg1Ig4K-aRSiA0Rg5N0JGnqcv3I49TlGHFs=) Every day, I carry with me that I am a descendent of enslaved people, people who knew that they would not make it, but dreamed and prayed that one day I would. Their prayers carried me to this day – carried me through a life of public service as a social worker, as a law enforcement officer, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's police chief, and as the proud representative of Florida's 10th Congressional district. **So hear me when I say this: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the ’60s, have an amazing story of opportunity like mine.** The prayers of my parents propel me forward, even now, giving me the strength and courage it takes to do what's right. To impeach and prosecute a corrupt president. To never stop fighting for gun safety reform. To push for truth, accountability, justice. [**I stand on the side of our democratic institutions, on the side of everyday working Floridians – but I need your help to win this race. Will you split a contribution of $20 or more to Serve America and me to defeat Marco Rubio, win in Florida and defend our Democratic Senate majority?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44334671/341171111/-74008005?refcode=20220420_Demings&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzczNGE4Zi1iZGMwLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YBLpJSiWrg1Ig4K-aRSiA0Rg5N0JGnqcv3I49TlGHFs=) In my decades of public service, I've worked with some truly incredible individuals – champions of civil rights like my friend John Lewis, who said, "Each generation must do its part to create an even more fair, more just society." We're at an inflection point for our democracy that will decide if we live up to John Lewis' dream, friend. The modern-day Republican Party is committed to the exact opposite of what Congressman Lewis stood for. Marco Rubio and Senate Republicans grow more extreme by the day, more committed to a dangerous, anti-democratic agenda. Putting party over the future of our democracy, over the wants and needs of Florida's working families. You have my word, that when it comes to winning this race and delivering better leadership for Florida, I will fight like never before. Because when your friends and neighbors put their trust in you to be their voice, you work for them – and that's just not what we're seeing from Sen. Rubio. But it's only together that we'll have a shot at winning – so here's what I'm counting on: **6,112 donations, before 11:59 p.m. tonight. majority!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44334672/341171112/-74008005?refcode=20220420_Demings&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzczNGE4Zi1iZGMwLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YBLpJSiWrg1Ig4K-aRSiA0Rg5N0JGnqcv3I49TlGHFs=) clean_body: | | | = Friend, I'm Val Demings, and I'm running for the U.S. Senate to defeat Marco Rubio and win better, stronger leadership for the people of Florida. Just 10,033 votes (0.2 percentage points) decided Florida's last Senate race – so I'll tell you the plain truth: I cannot win this without you. = Every day, I carry with me that I am a descendent of enslaved people, people who knew that they would not make it, but dreamed and prayed that one day I would. Their prayers carried me to this day – carried me through a life of public service as a social worker, as a law enforcement officer, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's police chief, and as the proud representative of Florida's 10th Congressional district. So hear me when I say this: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the ’60s, have an amazing story of opportunity like mine. The prayers of my parents propel me forward, even now, giving me the strength and courage it takes to do what's right. To impeach and prosecute a corrupt president. To never stop fighting for gun safety reform. To push for truth, accountability, justice. = In my decades of public service, I've worked with some truly incredible individuals – champions of civil rights like my friend John Lewis, who said, "Each generation must do its part to create an even more fair, more just society." We're at an inflection point for our democracy that will decide if we live up to John Lewis' dream, friend. The modern-day Republican Party is committed to the exact opposite of what Congressman Lewis stood for. Marco Rubio and Senate Republicans grow more extreme by the day, more committed to a dangerous, anti-democratic agenda. Putting party over the future of our democracy, over the wants and needs of Florida's working families. You have my word, that when it comes to winning this race and delivering better leadership for Florida, I will fight like never before. Because when your friends and neighbors put their trust in you to be their voice, you work for them – and that's just not what we're seeing from Sen. Rubio. But it's only together that we'll have a shot at winning – so here's what I'm counting on: 6,112 donations, before 11:59 p.m. tonight. Ohio will determine Senate control, and we cannot let this seat fall into the hands of an out-of-touch millionaire and Silicon Valley hack. That’s why I’m depending on you to step up right now, if you can.
Spilt a contribution between my campaign for Senate and CommonGood right now so we can flip Ohio blue, expand our Democratic Senate majority, and cut workers in on the deal. Title 42 isn’t enough to secure our border, but without it, illegal crossings will more than double to an estimated 18,000 per day! These Democrats have publicly opposed ending this policy, but when given the chance to vote to keep it, they voted the wrong way. We are tired of their empty words. They must act now and stop trying to trick voters, while at the same time appeasing their radical, left-wing party base.

---
**Get ready for your local and state primary election** In many states/areas, it’s the primary where the real battle happens. In red states, a Republican always wins the general election, so the real fight is in the primary. The same goes for blue states and Democrats. Primaries are really important, so... are you ready? Below, is a list of things to make sure you know and do before your primary election is held. We’ve tried to provide links where we can to help you get this done. **When is the date of your primary election?**
* [Statewide primary elections calendar](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
* Write the date on your calendar, put it in your phone, etc.

**When does early voting start and end in your state? Do you know what to bring?**
* [Early voting by state](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
* Write the dates on your calendar, put it in your phone, etc.
* IMPORTANT:****_It is really, really important to go vote early, on the first day, if possible. When you vote early, you remove the possibility that your vote could be stolen. It’s known as, “Claim your name, claim your vote.” Please try to vote as early as you can!_

**What are the absentee/mail ballot deadlines and procedures in your state?**
* [List of absentee/mail-in ballot request websites by state](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-Wn2VFg)
* [Absentee/mail-in voting procedures by state](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)

**Other important information you should research/know:**
* [Ballot curing](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) (this is where you are allowed to fix your absentee/mail ballot if you made a mistake – it is allowed in some states)
* [Where do I vote?](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
* [List of official voter registration websites by state](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
* [Contact your local election office](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._HhhQQexZ8bkPLQ) if you have questions
* [Polling location opening and closing times](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-uLasJGv_KqWMJt8YA)

**Call, text, and/or email everyone you know who is likeminded to make sure they know these important dates, and help them make a plan to vote!** **Ask people you trust, or look at truly conservative group recommendations for who to vote for in the primary, if you aren’t sure.** There is definitely still a battle raging between “establishment” candidates and conservative candidates, so do your research and take your list with you when you vote! **Last, but not least** **– Sign up to work as a poll worker!** Many of the irregularities in 2020 occurred because we didn’t have enough patriots working as poll workers. It is VITAL that we have as many patriots as possible in these positions to ensure there is transparency, honesty, and fair results. However, you can’t just wait to sign up in October. In many places, you need to get signed up now. [**Use this website**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._B2kXmFkyQ)**** to help you figure out who to contact and what your state’s requirements are to become a poll worker. Note that in some states they’re called election workers, or officers of election, etc.

body:
---
| | | | | | [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ss9g3bOIzWfWgqoHPcTtlb_1ArOB_9adqHKZ_7pjcgojmP_YCFVgp2KQfP6Cj5AlmZf2OQJiz-P6IcRO8L0jbIqQM1xWS8weRdEVCo3mkdNedkkASjnbBULyEKyLjJ6lCJcGfgbNCgdGOWD1Jj4AUX8n-QiuYpBg-8idUhztPNqq_fYvKtKFhQ==&c=qVwhCI_63yUsuAQ_08DBPgiqf1r6ZW2Mjk-5QrdcqdhsD_ZwGDvFMw==&ch=R8Ews6DDONRShufB2mH5I5VO39oIOi3HuAttRvix1SHCQnSlFk1WCg==)
---
| Peter \-
We wish to thank you for your interest in Kathy Barnette's campaign for the US Senate, representing Pennsylvania.
In case you haven't heard, Trump's recent endorsement of Dr. Oz has unexpectedly ignited massive interest in Kathy's campaign. In one week, we've seen as much as a tenfold increase in activity including donations, volunteers, social media, and requests for interviews from major media outlets including Fox, Newsmax, The Wallstreet Journal, and Hugh Hewitt's National Radio Show.
On April 15, a poll conducted by The Trafalgar Group revealed that Kathy has recently surged in the polls and is now in a statistical tie for first place. Trafalgar is considered to be one of the top polling services, and was one of the few polls to accurately predict Trump's victory in 2016.
With less than a month before the May 17 primary election, Kathy Barnette is putting the pedal to the metal. She is traveling 1500 miles per week to meet the voters across Pennsylvania. In between campaign stops, she is participating in virtual meetings and media interviews. Her schedule is jammed.
But she cannot do this all by herself. She needs your help and is inviting you to join our campaign team as a volunteer. Specific volunteer tasks include:
Social Media Warrior -- You will work remotely from your home with assistance from our Social Media Manager to boost Kathy Barnette's social media posts on Facebook, YouTube, etc. Finely targeted boosting on social media will allow Kathy to reach millions of PA voters.
Door Knocking -- Studies show that candidates that are presented at someone's front door have a 200% increased chance of earning their vote. The campaign will provide you with a list of registered Republicans in your area. You will knock on their door, provide a few simple talking points, and hand out a brochure to introduce them to Kathy. You can refer the voter to Kathy's web site if they have any policy questions or want more information about Kathy.
Phone Calling -- The campaign will provide you with a list of registered Republicans in PA, and you will call them from your home to introduce them to Kathy, using a standard script. Often, when you call someone, you will get their voicemail box where you can easily connect them to a pre-recorded message from Kathy.
Poll Workers -- On Election Day (May 17) we need people to stand outside polling areas to hand out Kathy Barnette brochures.
Poll Watcher -- On Election Day, we need people to monitor voting inside the polling station to ensure that voting is conducted properly. Some training is required for this role.

## My First Op-Ed In The Oklahoma City Sentenial & 3 Important Updates
---
Recently, the [Oklahoma City Sentinel](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5408.1.1c24c474bf0e8cc70e0ced5c2e9e985e) published my first Op-Ed about the war Former Vice President Joe Biden is waging on the Oil & Gas industry and how we can implement an America First agenda in this area. Read the Op-Ed [here](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5409.1.8dad440178e7edf88e8aeebc38e6ce80): [www.city-sentinel.com/government/bidens-war-on-american-energy/article_da7863c0-bdc3-11ec-8097-eb26daaf3b4a.html](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5410.1.b932872c923d7e28ec1b53ca9b4f9530) 3 Important Updates: **Update #1** \- Today is April 20, 2022 and [James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5411.1.50b39cd20081c360ed4db25f28f888b7) is still **refusing to debate**. Yesterday, while being interviewed on **KRMG** he stated that _all 9 of his opponents want a debate with him_ (which is not true). However, it doesn't matter how many Democrats filed for office and want to debate him; this a Republican Primary that is going to be determined on June 28th between [Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5412.1.fc976a47eab7aaef9cf2ab92a0fb2d27) and [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5413.1.933bc8bf76ac8fcbb3c35280f13d4034). It needs to be made clear that [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5414.1.e00dd70517b59f8041c4c0551f12bc91) does not own the US Senate seat and **owes it to the people of Oklahoma and America** to give an account for his lackluster record. I encourage you to post on [Lankford's](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5415.1.c7a69f0ff9e2fa5a81dd57569ce3d29a) social media platforms calling on him to say yes to the[Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5416.1.09ebb9a91389100f6cc25dd0e118ccca) vs [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5417.1.e509d58efe64c11448d84df815f15ad2) debate. **Update #2** \- A recent poll was released by **Just Oklahoma Data** that surveyed 867 _likely_ Oklahoma Republican primary voters via text message: [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5418.1.62a31d822d5722ee8c8a81e7a3910631) received 46.83%, [Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5419.1.9bbf3a9c62ebf60110e6fbf3a8aaf825) 35.87% and 17.3% were undecided. We have gained so much ground in such a short amount of time against a career Politician with the DC machine behind him. We have had **over 8000 individuals donate** to the campaign, **rallies with thousands** of Oklahomans in attendance and **national endorsements** from _Roger Stone_ , _Mike Lindell_ , _Sebastian Gorka_ , _OKGOP Chairman John Bennett_ and others. Over the next 2.5 months, please utilize your **Time** , **Talent** and **Treasure** to make sure we go 35.87% to over 50% on June 28th. We will win this battle if each of us does our part. If you live in Oklahoma please consider hosting a Meet & Greet of 10-12 people at your home that I can come and share my vision with. To host a Meet & Greet please email Caitlin at Caitlin@jacksonlahmeyer.com **Update #3** \- **[General Michael Flynn](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5420.1.888a310bb29037321e986ac497667ec8)** is joining me this Saturday in Tulsa, OK at the new office of my good friend, **Clay Clark** , for what we will be an EPIC rally. Those who have already donated to the campaign in the past have **FREE tickets** for every upcoming event we host through June 28. RSVP [here](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5421.1.dcdac91147adf0d14af611b9a8b9b99b): [www.tickettailor.com/events/lahmeyerforsenateinc/684866](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5422.1.eb5c403a8c2d1aaae314135313aae33a) The Best Is Yet To Come! **\- Please pray for me and my family.** **\- Please make a post on social media showing your support.** **\- Please make a[donation](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5423.1.a9e0ff6e5c6f1c2489f1b777c129aef6) of any size today to the campaign so we can finish strong.** You can contribute at [www.jacksonlahmeyer.com/donate](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5424.1.a369888a81478fdc6ae60d78f82adca7) Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer Follow me on TruthSocial, GAB, [Facebook](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5425.1.a5c32bc784e7383df9bf946031cb4bfa), [Instagram](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5426.1.724286c6ce4c5def7be2bc2e7d41fc6f), [Twitter](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5427.1.b3b3bd0ecbf840ba5710e4df0fd78610), [Telegram](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5428.1.f8ad0a472a88cb893487200aee208586), GETTR & [YouTube](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7466609.5429.1.10f935ce8e930e84be3c048c60796323)).

Countdown to Primary Day!
As we approach the final weeks of the Primary, we need all hands on deck. We have several ways you can volunteer to help out.
We need volunteers to help us distribute literature in the district. Literature drops are easy, no-contact way to canvass, and they only take a couple of hours of your time! We simply hang literature on the doors of Democratic Primary Voters. Our next literature drop is scheduled for:
SATURDAY
April 23, 2022
Meet at 1pm
Spring Valley Elementary School
2051 Northern Durham Parkway
Durham, NC.
LET US KNOW YOU CAN COME [ashley@ashleywardforcongress.com?subject=Saturday%20Lit%20Drop&body=Count%20me%20in%21%20I%27ll%20see%20you%20there%21]
We need poll workers!
We need volunteers to work during Early Voting and on Primary Election Day to pass out literature at polling stations. Volunteers will pass out postcards to voters as they arrive at the polling station. It is so important that we make this final contact with voters - every vote counts!
If you are able to work at a polling site, please indicate your availability at the link below.

subject: My letter to Joe Biden
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY REPUBLICAN ATTORNEYS GENERAL ASSOCIATION
body:
I hate to say we told you so | | | [ ](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=15a0de1b1f&e=edf8a4d16d)
---
| | Friend,

At every turn and on every issue, Joe Biden and his administration have __**failed**__ the American people.

Nowhere is this more clear than his disastrous decisions last year to shut down the Keystone XL pipeline, halt oil and gas permits and impose crushing regulations on American energy.

_**We hate to say we told him so.**_

Biden's extreme policies have resulted in outrageous gas hikes, thousands of lost jobs, and the death of American energy independence.

Despite his deflections and unserious attempts to pin sky-high inflation on Putin, _Biden is directly to blame for America's energy crisis._

Earlier this week, I sent Joe Biden a letter calling out his administration's failed policies and demanding a return to an America First energy agenda.

**_It's simple._** Instead of cowering to foreign dictators and catering to the fantasies of Green New Deal demagogues, we must **unleash American energy** to once again fuel our nation and get these devastating gas prices under control.

**Republican Attorneys General have taken a stand against Biden's egregious, expensive policies**. Last year, we [sued the Biden administration](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=bfb0109fc8&e=edf8a4d16d) for shutting down the Keystone Pipeline, [challenged his oil and gas moratorium](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=5203829b0a&e=edf8a4d16d) and [fought his unconstitutional executive orders.](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=74c668d96d&e=edf8a4d16d)

In my letter, I told President Biden - _**it's never too late to admit your mistakes.**_ But until this administration can get its act together and reverse course, Republican Attorneys General will hold the line.

[**Can you contribute $10, $25 or more to support Republican Attorneys General on the frontlines of Biden's war on American Energ**](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=dd7f433ced&e=edf8a4d16d)[**y?**](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=31d0f4e3ab&e=edf8a4d16d)

Peter,

I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called _The Nation_ before last week. Now, I'll never forget it.

They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece.

There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this:

"Herschel Walker, the football star turned Georgia Senate candidate, is an animated caricature of a Black person drawn by white conservatives."
Or maybe this line:

"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."
It's shameful.

But the writer doesn't just take aim at me. He questions the support from folks like you, too:

"Most white people in the South vote 'R' like their entire white supremacist project depends on it."
Peter, I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign. However, can you imagine the reaction from the mainstream media if these things had been said about a Black Democrat? The outrage! There would be calls for the writer to be fired and the publication cancelled.

But I'm not calling for a protest of the author or a boycott of the publication's advertisers. Nothing like that.

_**I think the best answer is to prove them wrong at the ballot box.**_

Happy 4/20, Peter Willis!
Here’s a statistic that should make you angry: Black and brown people are **_FOUR TIMES_** more likely to be arrested for cannabis use than white people, despite white people using cannabis at a similar rate.
What we have to do, right now, is very simple: Legalize cannabis and expunge the criminal records of those previously convicted of nonviolent cannabis-related crimes.**This is more than a social issue — it’s about correcting decades of ill-informed, harmful policies that have put entire generations of young Black and brown people behind bars.**
Just earlier this month, the House passed the Marijuana Opportunity Reinvestment and Expungement (MORE) Act, which would 1) decriminalize cannabis and 2) even more importantly, expunge certain cannabis-related convictions.
Unsurprisingly, the bill is now stuck in the Senate, and we’ve got to up the pressure on Senators to do the right thing by their communities.****[**Add your name today to join Team Melanie in calling for immediate passage of the MORE Act!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnmBySm3b9euB0MhRGmncn9i6z5uR-WKfeaNEMQ4z7BRaiW2Og7aUUuRpTlcuxyzso_u6po-RiUOX_kp-mZgZuGA1RKtM4nPwzdjFpLoRmejVqitkTZfiY7WUu-O0UGLEZKzl4QV_dCoJmEXWhs_XFFT5wXzhmVF-QyZ07WBQywU2cxwT7k4P167TqukSe1bGjHAbwKR2a4gCCzgSJvthWM0VZm8fPwsi1eypY8TEm0Fywax3cI_qXA_XvovLEZVnmZwr7kVn7xR_KGJM_p_LoUmvqjssXZZ5ahYv8avm1aZnl2EqjWd9VNbelt7Z6mxinlxCZMdYrY1iWg4CsV_Aaqt/3ld/W8I1E194Re-4Kl8ZNmqddA/h1/BpMBhBlgIFWlxLzCjkPEPL9aU0yYNTo26IJXEFLwu7s)

**It’s long past time we ended the cycle of mass incarceration that has destroyed working communities — especially communities of color.**
It’s ludicrous to hand out the same sentences for nonviolent cannabis-related offenses as we do for the truly destructive narcotics like heroin and methamphetamines. Classifying cannabis on the same level as these drugs is based in fear and racism — not science. It’s time we changed our laws accordingly.
The MORE Act won’t fix everything about how our criminal justice system disproportionately harms communities of color and perpetuates mass incarceration, but it’s absolutely a step in the right direction.

clean_body: | | | | Happy 4/20, Peter Willis! Here’s a statistic that should make you angry: Black and brown people are FOUR TIMES more likely to be arrested for cannabis use than white people, despite white people using cannabis at a similar rate. What we have to do, right now, is very simple: Legalize cannabis and expunge the criminal records of those previously convicted of nonviolent cannabis-related crimes.This is more than a social issue — it’s about correcting decades of ill-informed, harmful policies that have put entire generations of young Black and brown people behind bars. Just earlier this month, the House passed the Marijuana Opportunity Reinvestment and Expungement (MORE) Act, which would 1) decriminalize cannabis and 2) even more importantly, expunge certain cannabis-related convictions. Unsurprisingly, the bill is now stuck in the Senate, and we’ve got to up the pressure on Senators to do the right thing by their communities.** It’s long past time we ended the cycle of mass incarceration that has destroyed working communities — especially communities of color. It’s ludicrous to hand out the same sentences for nonviolent cannabis-related offenses as we do for the truly destructive narcotics like heroin and methamphetamines. Classifying cannabis on the same level as these drugs is based in fear and racism — not science. It’s time we changed our laws accordingly. The MORE Act won’t fix everything about how our criminal justice system disproportionately harms communities of color and perpetuates mass incarceration, but it’s absolutely a step in the right direction. Melanie Melanie D'Arrigo is a mother of three and healthcare advocate running for New York's 3rd District on Medicare for All and the Green New Deal. Hey everyone,

I wanted to write you a note ahead of the debate tomorrow. My team and I have been busy getting ready, but I want to tell you a few things as we reach this crucial point in the campaign.

We're less than a month out from primary day, and it's clear that the biggest group of voters in Pennsylvania are the ones who haven't made up their minds. There's a reason for that — PA voters haven't had a chance to see all of the candidates on the debate stage.

That changes tomorrow, and I'm excited to give people the opportunity to hear directly from us.

Tomorrow will be a big moment for our campaign. Voters will be tuning in and paying attention, and I'm confident that our message will win.

I believe we need to end the filibuster gridlock in the Senate, protect our democracy, protect the right to choose, raise the minimum wage to $15 an hour, and level the playing field for working people. **But first we need to win in November.**

I'm confident our campaign is the one that can win.

I know what it takes to win in a district that voted for Trump by almost 20 points. I’m the only Democrat in this race who has had the experience of winning tough races against Republicans, and I want to do it again and deliver for working families in Pennsylvania.

Tomorrow, we'll win over voters with our message. But the election doesn't end there. My team has a month-long sprint to the finish line, and we need the resources to get there.

With your strong support, I received 33% in the straw poll asking who would you vote for to take down the Left's favorite Democrat, Jennifer Wexton, this November.
I want to personally thank everyone that supported me last evening and hope you will relay to your friends and neighbors the momentum we are experiencing. Republicans have an opportunity this year to continue the "red wave" we shared with the election of Governor Youngkin, Lt. Governor Sears and Attorney General Miyares in 2022.

| Lifelong Loudoun County resident and business owner, Caleb was recently recognized by the [Loudoun Times 40 under 40](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Cquy4iIH78lxGkh_yKQ7ToH7pCqSwDjpKYYaMMsrlm1AE9DGVSH4vDOkw4T-D09CGzzD6MHGtUyyV_1cVDQqiFd6_24yb2l_-VlR4pf21rDv3QMJHKMYWlREAn1dWgFq4Zzuqz0I6Us_Og1uRUI48bgiQSxORLikVc67blHKTFnA15ociMsHFCa_d2zIMBDBN0R4PsaSB7bF8dqvIHv1i9YAMp482V4Em2vbc646nZ1pWgUcgQx_CLKJ0D1tJ7EUb4FqvzkssYEyMLWuUXwAQw==&c=hj2XKK2IignokAZZym3brFUtU41-uHp06Meu90kDXn_hf4-oHJK3xQ==&ch=OsF-jkQsASbdKV_voxXCha44HjarF-28h9fbR1oWf53ij2mW-Afv2Q==) as a business and community leader. He founded one of Western Loudoun's largest landscaping companies and is the grandson of former US [Representative Frank Wolf](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Cquy4iIH78lxGkh_yKQ7ToH7pCqSwDjpKYYaMMsrlm1AE9DGVSH4vCtAjs8BabOhBnEnHrT0dGraLrKYp545U4PMUccny7oKqXqfQlxqQCV80h9V2BmTWZHeDde3V_5REgeHDTKOWf9itamYuzHnFjpVjRhbWf7qc7X7JWc-MX7JPnYnJ9kn71cXRgjbUIUp&c=hj2XKK2IignokAZZym3brFUtU41-uHp06Meu90kDXn_hf4-oHJK3xQ==&ch=OsF-jkQsASbdKV_voxXCha44HjarF-28h9fbR1oWf53ij2mW-Afv2Q==) who served the 10th Congressional District for 34 years, having been first elected in 1980.
Caleb continued his entrepreneurial activities with the purchase of the Pica Deli in Reston and the establishment of his home, a 40 head cattle beef farm, in Round Hill. He grew up as an active member of 4H in Loudoun County and is a member of the Virginia Farm Bureau and Blue Ridge Cattlemen's Association.
Like his grandfather, Caleb is passionate about the international human rights movement. He founded a national, bipartisan non-profit organization called the [Athenai Institute](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Cquy4iIH78lxGkh_yKQ7ToH7pCqSwDjpKYYaMMsrlm1AE9DGVSH4vDOkw4T-D09C2V-91V6QkqnQYu-qhpQP-A2Mv6wadj9wfR2z3UchUr-rtJfZXcTVrEpM-yZDKyaJCKIw-Uj5n4Y=&c=hj2XKK2IignokAZZym3brFUtU41-uHp06Meu90kDXn_hf4-oHJK3xQ==&ch=OsF-jkQsASbdKV_voxXCha44HjarF-28h9fbR1oWf53ij2mW-Afv2Q==) and joined in starting Stand Against Chinese Communism (SACC). Both organizations are working to eliminate Chinese Communist Party influence on our college campuses. Caleb has taken a specific interest in fighting the genocide of the Uyghur Muslims and recently was recognized by the Virginia Muslim Association for his assistance to the Afghan refugee and Muslim community after President Biden's botched and deadly withdrawal from Afghanistan.
Caleb is ready to fight for you and all the citizens of the 10th Congressional District!! name: Herschel Walker
subject: “Any old Black person will do.”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece. | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60187845:JxHM3Go2N:m:1:3317145305:871F485D628B776C5D08FE2CDFE09F5F:r)

---
Peter,

I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called _The Nation_ before last week. Now, I'll never forget it.

They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece.

There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this:

"Herschel Walker, the football star turned Georgia Senate candidate, is an animated caricature of a Black person drawn by white conservatives."
Or maybe this line:

"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."
It's shameful.

But the writer doesn't just take aim at me. He questions the support from folks like you, too:

"Most white people in the South vote 'R' like their entire white supremacist project depends on it."

body:
In order to turn out a historic number of voters on Election Day, we need all hands on deck.
#
Right now, we’re building one of the biggest organizing programs Texas has ever seen so we can make history and elect Beto as our next Governor.

Team Beto volunteers have already accomplished some amazing things. **But in order to turn out a historic number of voters on Election Day, we need all hands on deck.**

We’re reaching out to you because our campaign needs your help to make direct, personal contact with as many Texans as we can.
[**Will you sign up today to write letters to to Texans and help build support for Beto?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/52815?utm_source=ema20220420-185768&t=1&akid=185768%2E444211%2EibZ9TV) You'll have the opportunity to meet other supporters after a brief training. Plus, our letter-writing events are hosted virtually, so you can join us from anywhere.
**[Write letters for Beto »](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/52815?utm_source=ema20220420-185768&t=2&akid=185768%2E444211%2EibZ9TV)**
Winning in Texas won't be easy, especially with the extreme voter suppression happening right in front of our eyes. But we know that we're capable of generating once-in-a-lifetime voter turnout if we put in the work right now.
Thank you for being part of this,
Katherine Fischer
Organizing Director, Beto for Texas
