# Dave White took $1.4M of government bailout money, left taxpayers to foot the bill
_White has not paid back the enormous sum, despite donating $4M to his own campaign _
**West Chester, Pa.** **\--** The McSwain for Governor campaign today shared that gubernatorial candidate Dave White, despite claiming to be a vocal opponent of paycheck protection programs, took $1.4M in [government bailout money](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=96da767318&e=b1ec95759b) to fund his businesses in 2020.

The loans were distributed via the Paycheck Protection Program under the CARES Act. The Paycheck Protection Program was established to help small businesses struggling with decreased profits pay their employees. White had no issue taking the hand-out, and has seemingly made no attempt to return the money to the taxpayer, despite the ability to do so.

The entirety of White's $1.4M in debt was forgiven in full. The largest of White's loans, $758,063 given to White's business DWD Mechanical Contractor Inc., was forgiven in full on July 29, 2021. That same year, White was able to donate $3M to his campaign, and has since donated a total of $4M to fuel his candidacy.
---
|
---
| _The same year Dave White relied on $1.4M of government money to fund his businesses, he was able to put $3M of his own money towards his gubernatorial campaign. _
---
|
---
| James Fitzpatrick, campaign manager for Bill McSwain, had this to say:
---
|
> _**“Dave White took $1.4 million dollars in taxpayer loans to fund his businesses. Like a true career politician, White has no problem fleecing hard-working families to pay his debts while he claims to 'self fund' a failing campaign. **__**White should** **not spend another cent on his campaign until these loans are repaid to the taxpayers."**_
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: ** \- Dave White has given $4M to his campaign to date
\- Of that, $1.4M was funded by taxpayers via the unpaid government loans
\- Taxpayer dollars and liberal donors, including donors of Hillary Clinton, Joe Biden, and Tom Wolf, make up 35% of White's total campaign income ###

body:
#

Growing up, this little boy learned that through hard work, he could do anything he set his mind to.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-apr22?refcode=em220420-1-7&t=1&refcode2=2621_6688874_Mtn7xy&akid=2621%2E6688874%2EMtn7xy)
At the age of 23, he became a United States naval aviator. He deployed twice on the U.S.S. Midway and flew 39 combat missions in Operation Desert Storm.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-apr22?refcode=em220420-1-7&t=2&refcode2=2621_6688874_Mtn7xy&akid=2621%2E6688874%2EMtn7xy)
Then, at the age of 32, he was selected as an astronaut (with his twin brother, Scott!). He flew his first of four missions into space in 2001 aboard Space Shuttle Endeavour. He spent more than 50 days in space and has lived on the International Space Station.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-apr22?refcode=em220420-1-7&t=3&refcode2=2621_6688874_Mtn7xy&akid=2621%2E6688874%2EMtn7xy)
In 2011, Mark's wife, Former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, was shot in Tucson during an event where she was meeting with her constituents. Mark retired from the Navy and NASA, and his mission turned from service to his country to caring for his wife. But Gabby's service in Congress, using policy to improve people's lives, stuck with him.
So, in 2020, Mark took on his next mission — running for U.S. Senate in Arizona — and won. Since he was sworn in, Mark has been focused every day on making Washington work for all Arizonans.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-apr22?refcode=em220420-1-7&t=4&refcode2=2621_6688874_Mtn7xy&akid=2621%2E6688874%2EMtn7xy)
Now, Mark is up for re-election in 2022 and needs your help to keep fighting for us in the Senate. News broke this week that a Mitch McConnell-backed Super PAC is putting down $14 million to beat Mark. That’s after more than $10 million has already been spent against him, with millions more committed by his opponents.
It’s pretty clear: This is going to easily be one of the hardest fought Senate races in the country. And we need your help.
So, please:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution before our April fundraising deadline ends to help re-elect Mark Kelly to the Senate? Mark can’t do this alone, it’s going to take all of us working together.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-apr22?refcode=em220420-1-7&t=5&refcode2=2621_6688874_Mtn7xy&akid=2621%2E6688874%2EMtn7xy)

Thank you for being a part of this team,
Team Kelly

Fellow American,

I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called _The Nation_ before last week. Now, I'll never forget it.

They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece.

There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this:

"Herschel Walker, the football star turned Georgia Senate candidate, is an animated caricature of a Black person drawn by white conservatives."
Or maybe this line:

"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."
It's shameful.

But the writer doesn't just take aim at me. He questions the support from folks like you, too:

"Most white people in the South vote 'R' like their entire white supremacist project depends on it."
Fellow American, I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign. However, can you imagine the reaction from the mainstream media if these things had been said about a Black Democrat? The outrage! There would be calls for the writer to be fired and the publication cancelled.

But I'm not calling for a protest of the author or a boycott of the publication's advertisers. Nothing like that.

_**I think the best answer is to prove them wrong at the ballot box.**_

clean_body: [] Dear Peter, I’m honored to have received the endorsement of Senator Nancy King! As a proud resident of Montgomery County, I’ve admired Nancy’s work for many years. She’s fought for progressive education reforms to empower our students and teachers, supported investments to strengthen our economy, and brought greater transparency to the General Assembly. She’s one of Maryland’s most dynamic leaders, and I am so humbled to have received her support. [] Nancy, I can’t thank you enough for your friendship and trust. As Maryland’s next Governor, I’ll proudly work with you to deliver the concrete results that our communities deserve. From combating climate change, to tackling student debt, to creating new family-supporting jobs, we have an opportunity to redefine the promise and possibility of government in the years ahead. The people of Maryland know me, and I know them. During my time as Comptroller, I’ve visited every community across the state, from Accident to Crisfield and every ZIP code in between. I’ve built an unparalleled coalition of support with leaders who span all of our counties and Baltimore City, and I’ll proudly work hand-in-hand with them to secure a stronger future for our state. With your critical support, [] we can win this competitive race and deliver the concrete results that Marylanders need and deserve. We are closer to the finish line than any other team in this race – but we can’t win on momentum alone! Will you help us meet our fundraising goals so that we can keep firing on all cylinders during this final stretch of the race? We’re looking to raise an additional $2,275 by 11:59 PM tonight, and a groundswell of grassroots donations can easily get us there. subject: Is voting against the PRO Act "anti-union activity?"
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, there was
some encouraging news from the Democratic Party yesterday. It plans to
ensure its consultants aren’t engaging in anti-union activity.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/103887?refcode=em20220420-22943&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=22943%2E1203867%2EKF9bMX ]Tweet from Politico reporter Eleanor Mueller that reads SCOOP: The
Democratic Party plans to add an addendum to contracts with consultants
that would forbid them from any — really, any — anti-union activity. I got
the doc, which comes after reports that Dem pollster GSG aided Amazon's
union-busting efforts.

BUT, what about the Democratic Party’s own lawmakers? Rep. Henry Cuellar
was the ONLY House Democrat to vote against the PRO Act — legislation that
would empower workers to freely and fairly form unions, strengthening
labor rights in America. Isn’t Cuellar’s vote “anti-union activity?”

We think so and it’s why we recruited Jessica Cisneros to run against him
in TX-28. Jessica’s runoff against Cuellar is less than 5 weeks away, and
we need your help to elect Democrats who will back THE PEOPLE, not
union-busting corporations.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/103887?refcode=em20220420-22943&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=22943%2E1203867%2EKF9bMX ]Can you split a contribution of $3 right now to
Jessica’s campaign and Justice Democrats? Your grassroots donations will
support our work to elect Jessica and a slate of progressive primary
challengers who will always fight for workers.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/103887?refcode=em20220420-22943&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=22943%2E1203867%2EKF9bMX ]Contribute $3

We know corporations, Big Oil, and Republican mega-donors are backing
Cuellar. We know pro-life groups are backing the anti-abortion incumbent.
Cuellar is out-of-step with even the Democratic establishment. But he
still has the support of Democratic House leadership, including Speaker
Nancy Pelosi.

We agree with the Democratic Party’s move to ensure its consultants don’t
engage in anti-union activity. We also believe Democrats should be backing
the choice for unions and workers in TX-28, that’s why we’re backing
Jessica.

We’re working to transform the Democratic Party by electing progressives
who will truly put the people first. That’s why we have to unseat
corporate Democrats who care more about protecting corporate profits than
protecting workers. Jessica and our entire 2022 Justice Democrats slate
will always fight for workers.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/103887?refcode=em20220420-22943&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=22943%2E1203867%2EKF9bMX ]Will you split a $3 donation to Jessica and Justice
Democrats to help us defeat Cuellar, elect our slate, and fight for the
rights of workers to organize?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/103887?refcode=em20220420-22943&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=22943%2E1203867%2EKF9bMX ]Contribute $3

Thank you for all that you do to support our work and our primary
candidates.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1024&akid=22943%2E1203867%2EKF9bMX ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1025&akid=22943%2E1203867%2EKF9bMX ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220420-22943-footer&t=1026&refcode2=22943_1203867_KF9bMX&akid=22943%2E1203867%2EKF9bMX

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1027&akid=22943%2E1203867%2EKF9bMX

Menomonee Falls, WI 53051

Mike Van Someren

clean_body: U.S. Green Berets operated under the radar to help train Ukrainian warriors to defend their homeland. Peter, U.S. Green Berets operated under the radar to help train Ukrainian warriors to defend their homeland. Now, we’ve seen the fruits of their labor as Ukrainians inflicted heavy losses on Putin’s invading forces. Vladmir Putin isn’t getting the cakewalk he expected, and I’m extremely proud to be a Green Beret and support the Ukrainian people as they fight this evil tyrant. But the truth is, it never should’ve gone this far. If Joe Biden followed President Trump’s lead and keep his sanctions on Russia’s oil, Putin wouldn’t have had the resources to carry out these heinous attacks. But instead of facing our enemies, Joe Biden caved to green energy zealots, kneecapped American oil and gas, and made us beggars for vicious dictators’ oil. With such incompetency in the White House, it’s vital that I defend my seat in Congress, FIRE Nancy Pelosi, and usher in a Republican House Majority committed to peace through strength. Will you help me build a Republican majority that will destroy America’s enemies and stop evil dictators like Vladmir Putin? In Service, Col. subject: We need gun control legislation now.

body:
Dear Friend,

This past weekend in Pittsburgh, in the early hours of Easter morning, more than 90 rounds were fired from multiple guns at an Airbnb, killing two juveniles and injuring many others. It was a senseless tragedy that changed the lives of so many families and cut short the lives of two young people.

We need to demand that our legislators create and pass policies that help prevent shootings like this one last weekend. Instead, just this December, PA lawmakers passed legislation to allow anyone who wishes to carry a concealed gun to be able to do so without a background check and permit! Thankfully, Governor Tom Wolf vetoed it. But these close calls are WAY too close for comfort.

TAKE ACTION TODAY. Let your legislators know that it is THEIR JOB to protect us from gun violence.
[https://keystoneprogressaction.com/we-need-gun-control-legislation-now/]

At Keystone Progress, we are mobilizing voters and organizing in PA towns that voter groups rarely visit to make sure that voters are empowered and that their ballots are counted. Together, we can work so that politicians who care about their constituents are elected and not ones who pass irresponsible, dangerous gun laws.

Thank you for standing with us and taking action today!

Jenna Henry
Keystone Progress

The Senate plans to introduce the _Cannabis Administration and Opportunity Act_ this spring, which would remove cannabis from the controlled substances list, forgive non-violent cannabis-related offenses, and make it accessible _and_ legal for veterans across the nation.

**37 states across the country have decriminalized cannabis.**
A majority of Americans agree that cannabis should be legalized for medicinal or recreational purposes, but our federal legislation is lagging decades behind popular opinion.
Our current regulations ignore evidence that cannabis can help with myriad medical issues, including veterans coming home with PTSD.

body:
All across the country, threats to election officials are on the rise.
#

Friends -
All across the country, threats to election officials are on the rise.
It’s no surprise. Not with Trump’s efforts to undermine the 2020 election results. Not with inflammatory rhetoric encouraging violence against public officials.
But this is a widespread reality. The Department of Justice documented more than 850 threats to election officials.
In 2020, only six states generally prohibited guns at the polls.
More states need to act.
Protecting our country’s democracy from extremism is complex work that Congress and state legislatures must tackle. But one thing is clear: prohibiting guns at polling places and ballot counting centers is common sense.
Legislators must act now to pass these laws ahead of the 2022 midterms, or it’s very easy to see people getting hurt.

Happy 4/20, Peter! Today would be a great day for the Senate to pass the MORE Act and decriminalize marijuana on the federal level. **Decriminalizing marijuana is more than a social issue: It’s about restorative justice and ending the cycle of mass incarceration in this country.** The Marijuana Opportunity Reinvestment and Expungement (MORE) Act passed the House earlier this month, and would 1) decriminalize marijuana and 2) even more importantly, expunge certain marijuana-related convictions. Now the bill is facing an uphill battle in the Senate. clean_body: | = Happy 4/20, Peter! Today would be a great day for the Senate to pass the MORE Act and decriminalize marijuana on the federal level. Decriminalizing marijuana is more than a social issue: It’s about restorative justice and ending the cycle of mass incarceration in this country. The Marijuana Opportunity Reinvestment and Expungement (MORE) Act passed the House earlier this month, and would 1) decriminalize marijuana and 2) even more importantly, expunge certain marijuana-related convictions. Now the bill is facing an uphill battle in the Senate. | The criminalization of cannabis has disproportionately harmed communities of color more than anyone else in this country. Black and brown people have been locked up for decades for non-violent marijuana-related offenses, perpetuating the cycle of mass incarceration and systematic inequality. As a doctor, I can tell you right now that it’s ludicrous to hand out the same sentences for marijuana offenses as we do for serious, addictive, and destructive narcotics like heroin and methamphetamines. Health professionals know that classifying marijuana on the same level as these drugs is based in fear and racism — not science. It’s time we changed our laws accordingly. The MORE Act is a big step in the right direction, but we need the Senate to do the right thing and pass this crucial legislation. Thanks, Dr. Yadira Caraveo | Yadira Caraveo is a pediatrician, state representative, and daughter of immigrants. Her parents raised her and her siblings on her father’s construction worker’s salary in Adams County. In the legislature, Dr. Caraveo has delivered for working Coloradans by standing up to the biggest corporate bullies and entrenched special interests. Cannabis decriminalization is far overdue in this country. The current patchwork of state laws doesn’t get to the heart of the issue while it still remains illegal under federal law.

As a fourth-generation farmer, I know there are more than enough barriers to making a living in small-scale agriculture – and cannabis farmers and business owners here in Washington and nationwide face an additional set of challenges.

[If you agree that it’s time for national cannabis legalization, add your name here. Congress came close with the Marijuana Opportunity Reinvestment and Expungement (MORE) Act, intended to remove cannabis from the list of federally controlled substances and enact criminal and social justice reforms. However, this bill has stalled in the Senate.

Another bill stuck in the Senate is the Safe and Fair Enforcement (SAFE) Banking Act. This would prevent regulators from penalizing banks that work with the cannabis industry, allowing cannabis businesses to bank as other businesses do, which includes accepting payment from credit and debit cards rather than relying solely on cash.

**Dan Newhouse voted against BOTH of these measures this year. Meanwhile, cannabis farmers and business owners – along with Black Americans targeted by the war on drugs – are bearing the brunt of the damage the longer this struggle continues.**

With just 13 days left until the election, I'm making the final push across Ohio on my statewide bus tour. I've met so many inspiring conservatives along my campaign tour and I'm looking forward to meeting more Ohioans in the coming weeks.

name: John Fetterman
subject: Happy 4/20, Derek! 🌿
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
To be clear, the last time I smoked weed in earnest was at Burning Man in 1999.
#
Happy 4/20, Derek!
**Today is a joyous occasion to not only *celebrate* weed, but to seriously commit ourselves to full marijuana legalization and ending the racist War on Drugs.**
So let me be as clear as possible here: I believe that weed should be legal, safe, and pure for medicinal and recreational use by adults across the country. Legal weed is good for farmers, small businesses, veterans, and people suffering from chronic pain.
Along with legalizing weed for recreational and medicinal use, **it is urgent that we expunge all marijuana records and release all those incarcerated for using the plant.** I cannot emphasize enough that marijuana prohibition in America is a grave racial injustice.
The data is stark: Black people are arrested for violating marijuana possession laws at nearly _four times_ the rates of white people. It's time to elect leaders who know that's beyond unacceptable — and who have the courage to speak up and do something to right this wrong.
As I have always said, fighting for legal weed in Pennsylvania and across the country is the right choice. Most importantly, from a social justice and equality standpoint, **when we legalize weed we can stop over 20,000 unjust arrests across Pennsylvania each year and work toward ending the War on Drugs.**
Look, Derek, I’ve always supported legal weed. Always will. Most Senate candidates don’t make legal weed a central part of their campaign platform, but I am.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/em-legal-weed-petition/?source=em20220420-5465&t=1&akid=5465%2E434096%2Evh09cC)
And with your support, I’ll be the LOUDEST (and tbh, probably the tallest) champion for legal weed and marijuana justice in the U.S. Senate.
**[So in honor of 4/20, I am asking for you to join me by adding your name to my petition to legalize weed and end the racist War on Drugs. By adding your name, you are joining the nearly 70% of Amerians who support legalizing weed.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/em-legal-weed-petition/?source=em20220420-5465&t=2&akid=5465%2E434096%2Evh09cC)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/em-legal-weed-petition/?source=em20220420-5465&t=3&akid=5465%2E434096%2Evh09cC)**
Thanks, Derek. I’m so grateful for your continued support.
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
P.S. Meet Lance the Weed Dog. Today is his birthday.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/em-legal-weed-petition/?source=em20220420-5465&t=4&akid=5465%2E434096%2Evh09cC)

Something about today, maybe the date, made me want to make sure that you know that as your next Governor, I’m committed to legalizing marijuana. It’s an issue so important to me and my campaign, I’ve made it a key tenent of my policy platform. AND I’m the only candidate in my primary and the general to publicly support legalizing marijuana. Check out our policy platform for proof.
CONTRIBUTE $4.20 TO OUR CAMPAIGN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/420tn]
This is a bipartisan issue, and as a governor for all Tennesseans, I will make sure that we do not lag behind on this issue. I want to legalize marijuana as 15 states have already done. As a result of legalization, those 15 states have taken power away from drug cartels and raised significant amounts of money for various programs including the education system. Opening up the cannabis market will also bring millions of dollars to communities across the state, allow farmers to take part in this lucrative sector, and employ thousands across this state in this new market.
Legalizing marijuana also provides valuable benefits to people who suffer from various ailments, small businesses who take part in the new market, farmers who can now grow a crop that helps their bottom line, school systems across all communities that benefit from the increased revenues, the overburdened criminal justice system, and a way out of opioid dependency. Our neighbor, Arkansas, has already legalized marijuana and is on track to bringing in nearly $60 million in funds for its communities.

# [DHS May be Defying Court Order by Failing to Properly Enforce Remain in Mexico Policy](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58670&L=27188&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZGhzLW1heS1iZS1kZWZ5aW5nLWNvdXJ0LW9yZGVyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNvcnJ1cHRpb24rY2hyb25pY2xlcyZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz)
The Biden administration may be defying a court order by failing to properly enforce a Trump policy that makes illegal immigrants wait in Mexico—rather than in the U.S.—for asylum hearings, a senior Homeland Security official confirmed this week. Known as the Migrant Protection Protocols (MPP) or Remain in Mexico, the policy was implemented in 2019 to mitigate the humanitarian and security crisis ignited by an unprecedented surge in migrants from Central America.

subject: Your 2022 Second Amendment Survey
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWYVSlUHNr

The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation's
history and undermine our Constitution-with a special emphasis on
eliminating the Second Amendment. Today, you're receiving
Hillsdale College's Second Amendment Survey because you're
someone who understands that education is essential to the
defense of liberty.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWYVSlUHNr

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend of the Constitution,

The far Left in America is attempting to
rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with
a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment.

Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's
Second Amendment Survey because you're someone who understands
that education is essential to the defense of liberty.

We are reaching and teaching millions of
Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this
without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding.

Could you take a few minutes to complete our
Second Amendment Survey using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Your timely survey answers will help us reach
and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year
about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights
protected by the Second Amendment.

There is no question that one of the Left's
most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our
liberty is ignorance.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing
truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in
1844.

Today our educational outreach efforts
include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty,
such as the Second Amendment.

As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler
observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions
of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first
principles."

This means the Second Amendment is essential
for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of
defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom.

This kind of thinking is foreign to most
college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are
now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an
example…

Not long ago, the University of Virginia
canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day.

Why?

The administration was concerned that firing
guns in honor of those who served their country and did their
part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student
body.

Unfortunately, there are many more such
examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the
ongoing decline in civics education in America.

But instead of just TALKING, it's more
important to DO something about it.

That's why we have been working to expand our
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

And this work continues today.

That's why I would like your answers to our
brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today
at this secure link:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

We believe that an educated citizenry is
essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan
said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from
extinction."

Do you agree? I hope so.

This is why we reach and teach millions of
Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution.
It's also why we need your help today.

As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from
much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Our independence from the government means
that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of
citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to
liberty.

It also means your gift really matters.

Today, you have a great opportunity to help
preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future
generations.

After completing your Second Amendment
Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous
tax-deductible gift today.

And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll
send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our
thank you.

This hat commemorates our partnership with
USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best
American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and
Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited!

Thank you for your time and attention. I look
forward to receiving your completed Second Amendment Survey.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

P.S. Our Constitution-including the Second
Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take
our Second Amendment Survey at the secure link below. It will
only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve
liberty for future generations. Thank you!

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Peter,

Twenty-three years ago today, a school shooting at Columbine High School in Colorado claimed the lives of thirteen students and teachers and injured dozens of others.

I remember the day clearly. I was in high school myself, and this type of violence on school grounds seemed unimaginable at the time. Unfortunately in the years since, acts of gun violence have skyrocketed.

And it's not just on school campuses where we're seeing these tragedies take place. From places of worship and grocery stores to nightclubs and concerts – no place is safe from the threat of gun violence.

**We can't wait any longer to take action on the gun violence epidemic.**

As State Treasurer, I've been working to restrict sales and purchases of firearm kits, components, and accessories used to assemble undetectable "ghost guns." And in Congress, I'll continue fighting to end gun violence with the same common-sense approach that I've taken as Treasurer and work to ensure legislation is signed into law that keeps our communities safe from gun violence.

Peter, Twenty-three years ago today, a school shooting at Columbine High School in Colorado claimed the lives of thirteen students and teachers and injured dozens of others. I remember the day clearly. I was in high school myself, and this type of violence on school grounds seemed unimaginable at the time. Unfortunately in the years since, acts of gun violence have skyrocketed. And it's not just on school campuses where we're seeing these tragedies take place. From places of worship and grocery stores to nightclubs and concerts – no place is safe from the threat of gun violence. We can't wait any longer to take action on the gun violence epidemic. As State Treasurer, I've been working to restrict sales and purchases of firearm kits, components, and accessories used to assemble undetectable "ghost guns." And in Congress, I'll continue fighting to end gun violence with the same common-sense approach that I've taken as Treasurer and work to ensure legislation is signed into law that keeps our communities safe from gun violence. Folks, Today is the first 4/20 since responsible, adult-use cannabis became legal in New Mexico. States that have legalized cannabis have seen a boom in business, tourism, and tax revenue — and a drop in incarceration. It’s important that adults who use cannabis do so responsibly, and legalization plays a helpful role in responsible use. It’s also an important step forward in ending the failed War on Drugs and helping our economy continue to grow and recover stronger than ever before. That's why it's so important to bring this momentum to the federal level. Earlier this month, the House voted to decriminalize cannabis and expunge nonviolent cannabis-related convictions, and I've proudly co-sponsored similar legislation in the Senate. [**We need to make responsible, adult-use cannabis legal in every single state. subject: These job-killing and government growing taxes need to STOP
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MICHELLE FOR MINNESOTA COMMITTEE
body:
We all know we are being overtaxed in Minnesota. These job-killing and government growing taxes need to STOP. | | | | [ ](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=3eae517d51&e=9d6926af69)
---
| | | Dear Fellow Republicans,

We all know we are being overtaxed in Minnesota. These **job-killing** and **government growing taxes** need to _**STOP**_. Our bottom rate of income tax is **higher** than the top rate of income tax in **24 states** and we are one of only 13 states that tax Social Security income. Furthermore, Minnesota also **[ranks 6 th ](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=334e8019a0&e=9d6926af69) **worst for our business tax climate and we have felt the impact of businesses fleeing our state.**_We NEED A CHANGE_!**

---
| [ ](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=fb25050e18&e=9d6926af69)
---
|
**Michelle’s Promise on Taxes**

_I will**NEVER** support a tax increase as your Governor_. Minnesota families pay enough already. When I am your Governor, seniors will not have to pay the outrageous double tax on Social Security and every Minnesotan will be spared from the atrocious Sick Tax.

Furthermore, our small businesses will not be destroyed by high taxes and burdensome regulations. We will reform the tax code to make sure our state values hard work and to create **JOBS, JOBS, JOBS**!

_**My tax cuts will be the largest of any candidate for Governor because I am the ONLY one who actually knows how to cut spending because I have done it!**_

**Give Us Our Money Back**

_**Our over nine-billion-dollar budget surplus belongs to the taxpayers of Minnesota**_. We deserve our money back in **permeant on-going tax relief!** No one-time Timmy Check gimmicks or more government programs. We need to **slash taxes permanently** if want to guarantee we don’t end up with more over taxation in the future.

As a Senator, I fought reckless Tax and Spend policies by**voting against every single tax increase** and by v**oting for billions in tax cuts**. Just this month [**I voted to eliminate the Social Security tax**](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=98e0b528da&e=9d6926af69) and **cut the first tier of income tax nearly in half**. I am also working to reduce skyrocketing property taxes that are pushing families out of their own homes.

_**Enough is Enough! I am Michelle Benson and with me, as your Governor, you will be getting your money back!**_

---
| **Your Support**

Together we can fight to create a Safer, Better, and Stronger Minnesota!

We have a long road to get through the state convention next month and the general election in November but we can defeat Tim Walz and put Minnesota on the right track.

**If you can help please donate by making a secure donation today at [https://secure.winred.com/michelle-for-minnesota/donate](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=ddc206a712&e=9d6926af69)**

Sincerely,

[](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=5c609ce3a5&e=9d6926af69)
Michelle Benson
[Candidate for Governor](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=1a341395e5&e=9d6926af69)

PS
Don’t hesitate to visit my website at [www.michelle4mn.com](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=5d36fcbdeb&e=9d6926af69) or to reach out via email: [Michelle@MichelleForMNGovernor.com](mailto:Michelle@MichelleForMNGovernor.com) or by phone at (612) 356-2256 if you have any questions or would like to volunteer to help my campaign.

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44344468/341208176/-1015736156?refcode=EM_FR_220420Judiciary1_J_TEAM_90DO_6_NG_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjlmMThjN2I4LWQ2YzAtZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=AxVq8eES5zaBlbS0Bu6ydAThHu_bZR_wJpDBucIODfA=)
| Fellow activist,

Hey friends,

As one of the main writers for BTE PAC, I have to say: I want to live in a world where I don’t have to write these emails because trans individuals are given the protections they deserve — both codified in law and upheld by all communities. But unfortunately, that isn’t the case.

We are still seeing bills being introduced that strip transgender individuals’ rights to make decisions on their own bodies and witnessing levels of violence that are unspeakable. Just a few weeks ago, Ohio introduced anti-trans legislation that would prohibit specific medical coverage for LGBTQ+ youth, specifically trans or nonbinary people. Alabama went so far as to pass a bill making it a crime to undergo gender-affirmation surgery to people under 19. Why is this happening?

Our endorsed candidate for Lieutenant Governor of Nevada, Kimi Cole, has faced her own trials and tribulations as a trans woman and active leader in the LGBTQ+ community. If elected, Kimi would be the first transgender person elected to statetwide office. This matters. Like many other trans youth, Kimi was told from a young age that feeling uncomfortable in her own body would be something she would “outgrow.” This is backwards thinking, and given the dangerous legislation coming through state legislatures and recent studies on suicide rates among LGBTQ+ youth, there has never been a more important time for trans visibility.

As an ally, I encourage cisgender folks to celebrate and lift up our transgender and non-binary friends and neighbors and offer support during this difficult time in the world through a grassroots contribution to support LGBTQ+ candidates breaking historic barriers.

**This should not be a matter of politics - it is a matter of human rights.**

[**Friends, will you stand with us and candidates like Kimi Cole so we can call out Republicans who so blatantly take away the rights and the voice of the transgender community? Please chip in $17 to help get Kimi Cole elected as Lieutenant Governor so she can promote inclusivity in Nevada.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wG78Ij5HBeK7_vav6LE6CXGDsjBBce8Ed_jOS_QDHDO_IsD5OoRxdaPthTur8dyRJoxopU1r6YrBXkWRhMmfghV8kA8q7VUo2AFahcE0QF17SqUA8I_bzZzvGI6r5kAYGRRzzTi9biuufj8r7nJy_mDJ5_qCMgcoGnhE0iMQ_0vW1ZKaoVYE4UnoinVuGbHSytm3NkVpNiGgGg5OJUxb4dcK6Xx6AhG0FESUtB7txqLzL3YPbITF750-yniKfzBBg4gsiNi73wm8KYEhaTNvM6tYc25kUHUhuyRUpO49IVWH_GT6EE9PPgMACSlFQN1Ys/3ld/HEEGzBHeTEmFlHuCpDfalA/h1/_O8x8zFZ8vLeW2Dza3QRZTGo_ocFT0-42UeK2lhP3Mo)

clean_body: Help Kimi Cole make history, Peter. | | | Hey friends, As one of the main writers for BTE PAC, I have to say: I want to live in a world where I don’t have to write these emails because trans individuals are given the protections they deserve — both codified in law and upheld by all communities. But unfortunately, that isn’t the case. We are still seeing bills being introduced that strip transgender individuals’ rights to make decisions on their own bodies and witnessing levels of violence that are unspeakable. Just a few weeks ago, Ohio introduced anti-trans legislation that would prohibit specific medical coverage for LGBTQ+ youth, specifically trans or nonbinary people. Alabama went so far as to pass a bill making it a crime to undergo gender-affirmation surgery to people under 19. Why is this happening? Our endorsed candidate for Lieutenant Governor of Nevada, Kimi Cole, has faced her own trials and tribulations as a trans woman and active leader in the LGBTQ+ community. If elected, Kimi would be the first transgender person elected to statetwide office. This matters. Like many other trans youth, Kimi was told from a young age that feeling uncomfortable in her own body would be something she would “outgrow.” This is backwards thinking, and given the dangerous legislation coming through state legislatures and recent studies on suicide rates among LGBTQ+ youth, there has never been a more important time for trans visibility. As an ally, I encourage cisgender folks to celebrate and lift up our transgender and non-binary friends and neighbors and offer support during this difficult time in the world through a grassroots contribution to support LGBTQ+ candidates breaking historic barriers. This should not be a matter of politics - it is a matter of human rights. name: Team Slotkin
subject: Fear-mongering comes to Michigan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congress[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87595/images/ElissaSlotkin_bigLogo.png]
Team,
In Michigan, we’re seeing an alarming trend in our politics, where Republican politicians use fear-mongering about our children’s safety to imply revolting things about Democrats and raise a quick buck for their campaigns in the process.
We saw it here in Michigan yesterday when Democratic State Senator Mallory McMorrow was accused in a fundraising email from a colleague across the aisle of “grooming” children and sexualizing them, bringing up horrible associations with crimes committed against children. Senator McMorrow gave a moving defense of her advocacy of the LGBTQ+ community, in a floor speech that you can watch here [https://twitter.com/MalloryMcMorrow/status/1516453738403143681] – check it out if you haven’t seen it already.
These comments about McMorrow were completely uncalled for, but they were not an isolated incident.
This week, Elissa’s opponent sent the following fundraising text message:
"CONFIRMED: (Your First Name), your child’s gender reassignment surgery has been booked. If you have any issues with this operation, please view the objectives of Biden’s National Transgender Strategy here,” followed by a contribution link to his campaign.

The text then leads you to a donation page claiming that recipients needed to make a contribution to his campaign in order to cancel this made-up appointment for a child’s “gender reassignment” tomorrow at 9 AM, going on to say that Democratic leaders are “forcing 5-year-olds to learn about gender reassignment surgeries, gender identities, and other radical ideas” and that we need to “stop this sick and twisted ideology from poisoning our children. If we fail, our children are doomed.”
Everyone, regardless of their political party, wants what’s best for our kids. Elissa focuses her campaigns on the issues she hears about most, and our kids’ safety and their future is one of them. That’s because we all want our children to grow up safe, happy, and healthy.
Using scare tactics about our children’s well-being to raise money for a political campaign should be off-limits. This is what people hate about politics: the politicians that only want to use fear to further divide us in a time where we should be coming together.
Hopefully the attention on this issue will get this use of fear out of fundraising. Especially when it’s about our kids. Elissa’s opponent has already changed a few words of the language on his link, possibly out of response to the national attention on Michigan. Thanks for your support of Elissa — and on keeping it clean!
Team Slotkin

body:
We are a definite go for a live District 4 candidate debate on May 5, from 6 to 8 p.m. at the Whiteside Theatre in downtown Corvallis.

**When: May 5, 2022, from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m.**
**Where: Whiteside Theater in downtown Corvallis**

Debate is sponsored by
* League of Women Voters
* OSU Associated Students of OSU
* OSU Sunrise (student environmental club)

We have confirmations from Sami Al-Abdrabbuh, Doyle Canning, Jake Matthews, Andrew Kalloch, Steve Laible, Tommy Smith and John Selker! Val Hoyle’s campaign has said she may attend; we are waiting to hear back from her.

Albany mayor Alex Johnson will moderate the debate. We are working with folks from OSU to livestream the event.

The 6:00 pm start time will hopefully work for folks who come from out of town - not too early or too late. More details to come in a few days.

See you on May 5th!

name: Alessandra Biaggi
subject: Happy 4/20! 🍃
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress
body:
#
Happy 4/20, everyone!
Today is a great day to talk about legalizing marijuana on the federal level.
**Last year, I joined other Democratic state legislators to support the Marijuana Regulation and Taxation Act (MRTA), legislation that finally legalized recreational marijuana in our state.**
Passing the MRTA opened up an avenue to create millions of dollars in revenue for our state and was an important step towards ending mass incarceration, which disproportionately impacts people of color.
In Congress, I plan to push for similar legislation so that adult Americans can legally enjoy recreational marijuana.
**[If you're with me, add your name here if you agree that Congress must legalize recreational marijuana.](https://act.alessandrabiaggi.com/signup/em220420-marijuana-survey/?source=em220420-1-15&akid=716%2E59515%2E8Mwtjm)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.alessandrabiaggi.com/signup/em220420-marijuana-survey/?source=em220420-1-15&akid=716%2E59515%2E8Mwtjm)**
Thanks for reading,
– Alessandra

It’s becoming more and more apparent that reckless politicians like Ron DeSantis pose a grave threat to our democracy.

Just take a look at all the harm DeSantis himself has already done right here in Florida: He’s pledged his allegiance to billionaire donors instead of everyday citizens. He’s supported and signed laws that suppress the vote, ban books, and outlaw discussions of LGBTQ people in public schools.

But despite all of that, there’s hope. “Democratic governors in states with GOP-controlled legislatures can **veto** voter suppression legislation and, in some states, extreme gerrymanders.”

“According to the Brennan Center, in January nearly **400 bills** were pending in 32 states to expand voting access. Where those proposals pass, they will only be signed into law by Democratic governors.”

“Another mounting fear is that in 2024, a Republican governor in a swing state could send a fake slate of electors for a Republican presidential candidate who **lost** the state’s popular vote.”

_— Washington Post Op-Ed_

That’s why I’m going to do everything in my power to defend our democracy from seditionists like you! [**And it starts right now with my $5 donation to Voter Protection Project »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/10023?t=12&akid=1884%2E878179%2EPzQtiX)

name: Erica Smith for North Carolina
subject: Let’s talk about 4/20
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ERICA FOR US
body:
We have to talk about who gets criminalized and punished for marijuana use.
#
**It’s 4/20 today and in case you didn’t know April 20th is a pretty mainstream holiday celebrating marijuana.**
As Marijuana usage has become legalized in states across the country, you can easily find a TON of CBD and THC based products hitting shelves across the country. Even Seth Rogan and Jay-Z have their own marijuana product lines.
But every year tens of thousands of North Carolinians are convicted for simple possession of marijuana.
That’s not even including the North Carolinians who are _already_ incarcerated serving harsh sentences for possession.
Seems unfair to you too? **This is straight up systemic oppression and racism.**
[**_Donate now to help us send Erica to Congress where she’ll fight to legalize marijuana and expunge the records of those unfairly punished for it »_**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/49622?t=1&akid=1110%2E3698%2EH_o4td)
**Let’s be real:** It’s regular everyday Black and brown folks who are still being punished for Marijuana possession.
Erica Smith is committed to bringing equity to North Carolina and that means legalizing marijuana, expunging records, and investing the tax revenue into those communities harmed the most.
It’s time we decriminalize Marijuana for _everyone_ — the legal cannabis industry is already a multi-billion dollar industry and it’s completely wrong that people are sitting in jail right now for something others are getting rich off of.
[**_If you’re with us, please chip in $5 to our campaign today to support Erica — a progressive champion who will fight for the everyday working people of North Carolina._**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/49622?t=2&akid=1110%2E3698%2EH_o4td)
**[Donate $5](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/49763?refcode=em20220420-1110&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1110%2E3698%2EH_o4td)**
With love and solidarity,
Team Erica Smith
Erica Smith is a single mother, educator, and three-term state senator, who grew up on her family farm and spent her life fighting for rural Eastern North Carolina. Now, she’s running to represent NC-01 — _her home district_ – in Congress, where she’ll fight for economic justice and workers’ rights, universal healthcare, voting rights, and more. **[Add a donation to help us protect this competitive, open U.S. House seat and give power back to working people »](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/49763?refcode=em20220420-1110-box&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1110%2E3698%2EH_o4td)** **[Donate](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/49763?refcode=em20220420-1110-box&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=1110%2E3698%2EH_o4td)**

subject: It’s time to legalize cannabis, Peter.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

It’s time to legalize and decriminalize cannabis,
Peter.

This plant is already legal for recreational use in 18 states and
Washington, D.C., and for medicinal use in 37 states and D.C.

Communities like mine have been ripped apart by the failed war on drugs.
It’s unacceptable that we’re still sending folks — disproportionately
Black folks, poor folks, and young folks — to jail and prison over it.

That’s why I promise when we defeat Rand Paul, we will fight for the
legalization and decriminalization of cannabis on the federal level, and
for transformative criminal justice reform.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220420?refcode=em20220420-other-1785&t=1001&refcode2=1785_346206_INw9hh&akid=1785%2E346206%2EINw9hh ]If you’re with me in this fight, can you make a $5
donation right now to our people-powered campaign? Every dollar you give
shows the strength of our grassroots movement.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220420?refcode=em20220420-1785&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&refcode2=1785_346206_INw9hh&akid=1785%2E346206%2EINw9hh ]Contribute $5 →

I support the full legalization and decriminalization of cannabis for both
recreational and medicinal use because I’ve seen how this so-called “war
on drugs” has turned into a war on people — especially people who look
like me.

I’ve seen families in my community become targets of a system that thrives
off the mass incarceration of brown and Black people.

Full legalization and decriminalization of cannabis will allow us to
empower people instead of prosecuting them. It will allow us to spend
fewer taxpayer dollars on needlessly locking people up and to bring in
much-needed additional revenue for state and local governments.

We’re seeing waves of change beginning in other parts of the country.
State leaders are taking the initiative to move toward criminal justice
reform and to re-frame the conversation around cannabis.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220420?refcode=em20220420-other-1785&t=1021&refcode2=1785_346206_INw9hh&akid=1785%2E346206%2EINw9hh ]It’s our job now to keep the ball moving and make sure we grow our
momentum. Will you help us send a loud message today that public support
is rising to legalize cannabis? Chip in $5 right now to
show your support for our campaign.

Thank you,

Charles

name: Malcolm Kenyatta
subject: anything is possible
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Malcolm PAC
body:
Even sending a real working person to the Senate — and yes, even a gay, Black one.
#

Friends:
I know there are people out there who say our movement can't win.
They say it's because I'm Black. Because I'm gay. Because I'm from a working-class family in North Philly.
Those naysayers have been counting us out from the beginning. Because what they don't count on is you.
I know that when we decide to do big things together, anything is possible. Even sending a real working person to the Senate — and yes, even a gay, Black one.
What the naysayers don't get is that this election is not about the color of your skin or who you love. It's about who you're going to fight for.
When I was a kid, we moved six times because my mom couldn't always afford the rent. She worked her butt off as a nursing assistant but had to ration her own insulin at home.
She taught me that the only way things will change is if you step up and do something about it. So, I began a life of service.
As a Pennsylvania State Rep, I've fought to raise the minimum wage, protect workers' rights, and combat gun violence. And I campaigned all across the state to help elect President Biden.
Now, I'm running for the United States Senate and I'm counting on support from this grassroots team to win.
We can have affordable health care, protect a woman's right to choose, and make our neighborhoods safer. But only if working people finally have a voice of our own in the Senate.
That's why I'm humbly asking you to do something today to help me get there. So what do you say?

Peter Willis,

Happy 4/20 y’all! Today, we have one thing on our minds: cannabis justice.

Black Americans are 3.6x more likely to be arrested on marijuana charges than white Americans, a racist enforcement strategy that has overcrowded our prison system with non-violent offenders and fueled “tough on crime” propaganda.

While people’s lives are being destroyed by archaic prohibition laws and a racist prison industrial complex, companies are making money on cannabis in states where it’s legal.

We need equity and justice. It’s high-time we legalize it for all and expunge the records of those arrested for marijuana possession.

A bill to do just that passed the House, but Senate leadership has failed to act. That’s why we need to keep up the pressure on corporate politicians in both parties!

Our Revolution is organizing across the country and on Capitol Hill to legalize cannabis fix our criminal justice system. With a monthly donation of $4.20 you can join the fight and receive a limited-edition Cannabis Justice sticker TODAY. Cannabis justice is a racial justice issue — full stop — and we’re not backing down from this fight. We must prioritize the lives of people of color, and legalizing cannabis is a step towards stopping the over-policing of marginalized groups and the unnecessary arrest of nonviolent offenders.

Solidarity!

| | Fellow Patriot:

Our families—our _children_ —are under the greatest sustained assault in our history.

Public schools are now nothing more than psychological torture camps.

Education has been replaced by the promotion of the depraved LGBT agenda, a Satanic attack on God and Nature. I call it LGBTP—the P is for pedophilia.

**These sodomite predators are grooming, brainwashing, and _mutilating_ our vulnerable children. These demons are _defiling _innocence itself, and they _must_ be stopped. **

Public school teachers have been caught giving _puberty blockers_ \--**life-altering drugs** \--to children _without parental consent._

I’ll give you just one recent example of what they’re doing to our children all over what used to be America: In California, a mother noticed that her teenage daughter was showing symptoms of depression. She asked her daughter’s school to keep an eye on her. They did.

The school brainwashed the girl into believing she was transgendered, and, when her mother insisted that she see a mental health professional, the school reported this poor mother to social services, who then declared her an unfit mother and took her daughter away. The State of California had already promised the girl it would pay for her “transition.”

This mother was restricted to visiting her daughter once a month, under State supervision.

_During these visits, she was prohibited from making any references to God._ Her daughter eventually committed suicide by throwing herself in front of a train.

And if you _dare_ to stand up for your own children, if you _dare_ to protect them, the Biden DOJ has labeled you a “ _domestic terrorist_.”

One father in Loudoun County, Virginia, was beaten bloody and dragged out of a school board meeting so he wouldn't be able to tell them about his daughter being raped in a school bathroom by a transgender freak.

[It's time for leaders in D.C. who aren't afraid to stand up and fight for our children, and for the sacred rights of parents.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=cca67595e1&e=eda539b26b)

**[_Our RINO incumbents are failing us every day by refusing to fight the Groomers on the Left_ _._](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=24976cd3eb&e=eda539b26b)**

[**_Help me_ _ defeat the Bipartisan Establishment __\-- Chip into my election campaign right away and show them the power of the America First movement_**](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=7ac602fdb1&e=eda539b26b) _._

_We need PATRIOTS who will**FIGHT** for the **AMERICAN** people, not limp-waisted frauds who never miss an opportunity to stab us in the back._

[_**Your contributions to my campaign will help me purchase TV and radio ads, yard signs, and other campaign materials so I can fight the worthless GOP, retire a weak RINO, and replace him with a fierce America First Warrior**_.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=254082f4c7&e=eda539b26b)

Thank you in advance for your generous support. For America,
Neil Robinson Kumar
_Republican for U.S. Congress, AR-03_

**P.S. The Republican Party of Arkansas is pulling out all the stops to kill my authentic America First campaign. ** [_**I know you're ready to replace these worthless RINOs with America First conservatives like me, and that's why I'm counting on your contribution of $5, $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more today**_](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=e60b33b8b7&e=eda539b26b)** _._**

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY REEVES FOR CONGRESS
body:
Former Chair of the Stafford Board of Supervisors, Del. Mark Dudenhefer, Joins Team Reeves
| | | [](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fbrycereeves.com/1/01000180487dea63-e62c1a34-5a64-4c23-ae34-b3332f8bd5fe-000000/hHaRBqo5d4yELgoG48_fEdWmL7M=267)
---
| **Bryce Reeves Announces Endorsement by Former Chair of the Stafford Board of Supervisors, Delegate Mark Dudenehefer** Today, Senator Bryce Reeves (R-Spotsylvania) announced a new endorsement for his campaign in the 7th Congressional District by Delegate Mark Dudenhefer (R-Stafford), former Chairman of the Stafford Board of Supervisors and former Delegate from the 2nd District. Delegate Dudenhefer said, “Bryce is a business owner in Stafford, somebody we know from both around the community and the General Assembly. Like myself, Bryce is a veteran who is committed to serving our community and never strays from a tough fight. And much like myself, Bryce has never had an easy election. Over and over I have seen Bryce defeat well funded Democrats in tight districts. I know he will defeat Abigail Spanberger this November, and that is why he has my total endorsement in the 7th Congressional District.” Bryce Reeves stated, “Mark Dudenhefer is a longtime friend and colleague. It's an honor and a blessing to have him on our team. He's a fighter, and I know he's going to fight tooth and nail to send Abigail Spanberger back home to Henrico County this November." name: Adam Schiff
subject: Sign On: Urge the Senate to pass the MORE Act
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
| I was proud to vote YES on the MORE Act in the House this month
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=197%2E5257348%2EKAvgCy)
Derek,
I was proud to vote YES on the _MORE Act_ in the House this month, a bill that would end the federal prohibition on cannabis by removing it from the list of banned controlled substances and begin to rectify the decades of failed policies that have derailed the lives of far too many of our people.
Cannabis reform is a bipartisan issue with widespread support among the majority of Americans. It’s already legal for adult use in 19 states including California, and medically legal in 36 states despite the federal prohibition. But while the legal cannabis industry generated $25 billion in sales last year, devoting the tax revenue to public goods like roads and schools, Washington is way behind the times.
It’s time for Congress to take action and remove cannabis from the federal list of controlled substances so we can keep the federal government up to date with state policies and address decades of injustice.
For far too long, convictions for minor nonviolent offenses have destroyed lives, torn apart families, and led to the disproportionate incarceration of people of color. By decriminalizing marijuana, we can make our justice system fairer and start to rectify the damage of some of the most destructive elements of the war on drugs.
The House already passed the _MORE Act_ — now it’s the Senate’s turn.
[**Add your name to my petition calling on the Senate to pass the _MORE Act_. We need to make it clear that the vast majority of Americans demand comprehensive cannabis reform.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/sign/engagement-20220420-more-act?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220420_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=197%2E5257348%2EKAvgCy)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/sign/engagement-20220420-more-act?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220420_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=197%2E5257348%2EKAvgCy)
---
Thank you for making your voice heard on this important issue. When we come together to apply pressure and push for change, we can accomplish so much.
My best,
— Adam

Join Team AOC in the fight for environmental justice by participating in our upcoming phone banking event for Earth Day!
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220420-2964-header&t=1&akid=2964%2E2526796%2EUv5t9L)
→ Celebrate Earth Day with Team AOC by joining our Green New Deal Phone Bank this Sunday. Read below for all the details. ←

**With temperatures rising and storms worsening, the need for comprehensive climate action has become all the more apparent.**
According to the United Nations' Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, curbing global heating to 1.5 degrees Celsius will require greenhouse gas emissions to peak before 2025 at the latest.1
Our mission is to rapidly transition our economy away from fossil fuels while creating millions of good-paying, union jobs in clean energy. **Alexandria refuses to leave anyone behind, which is why she’s led the fight for a Green New Deal in Congress.**
[**In honor of Earth Day, we’re hosting a virtual training and phone bank this Sunday from 1-4pm ET to talk to voters in the community about the Green New Deal. Will you join?**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13488?source=em20220420-2964&%3Butm_source=em20220420-2964&t=3&akid=2964%2E2526796%2EUv5t9L)

_Whether this is your first phone banking experience or your hundredth, we’ll be there to give you all the necessary information and support. After you sign up, we’ll send you all the info to join via Zoom._
This is an excellent way to connect with community members and learn the skills necessary to best participate in future phone banking events.
[**If you are able to make it, be sure to RSVP here.**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13488?source=em20220420-2964&%3Butm_source=em20220420-2964&t=5&akid=2964%2E2526796%2EUv5t9L)
We look forward to seeing you on Sunday!

I'm Aaron Jacobs, Maggie Hassan's Campaign Manager. I've been working with the Senator for a long time – since her gubernatorial reelection campaign in 2014 – and I've seen her accomplish a lot in these past eight years.
I was with her on election night in 2016. Long after the polls closed, Donald Trump was projected the winner, and Democrats across the country went to sleep uncertain about our country’s future, I was awake – preparing for a recount because the margin was so close in her New Hampshire Senate race. We watched with bated breath as the results trickled in from towns across the state, before finally the race was called and she held on with that 1,017-vote margin that flipped New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue.
I was with her for another long night in 2017: when Republicans tried to repeal the Affordable Care Act. It looked like they were going to succeed – until John McCain gave the pivotal thumbs down. We realized that night that if it weren’t for those 1,017 votes in New Hampshire, millions of Americans would have lost their health insurance.

The student and employer mandates are also dead. A fourth bill has been thwarted by a court decision, and two others haven't even been heard. Team,

| | Dear Peter, **** April 20 is an annual holiday in many circles, particularly here in my neighborhood, Haight-Ashbury. It played a special role in the emergence of psychedelic counter-culture in the 1960s. And while the community has been dramatically gentrified in the years since then, it remains a beacon of the same ethos that drove so many to look beyond conventional wisdom. I’m grateful, among other things, for the acceptance of traditional plant medicines expanding so far beyond my neighborhood. While laws decriminalizing cannabis at the state level continue to sweep across the United States, a great deal of work remains to be done. Congress needs not only to legalize cannabis at the federal level to enable banking services and interstate commerce, but also to legislate limits on grow operations to preserve space for small and family farmers and growers. [**Can you donate $4.20 or $42 to strengthen Congress by adding a voice committed to ending the racist war on drugs?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MIT6JXgJit7C5MMVe0ZDsS-GoHsWQIvcgS1-pn-Nz2a0DfKuLkbTs6SexMcnYODazmJKjjb9EPxrGDS4hwln7k-YcBN-JV056-ybEct_mW8CTugSlabTzummdJfcmiSU6pAHXCc003hClWBbdCZyDwCpymqLCNZ6XUCkW0-_TQ787zmTlWqCJbxa1PvYG70NMMkFL1wWUye9gy5jDbFWabubj6favtE9Xr0aahdda8pkKd4z5XocTWKdmKllgOC3pbOYjUZQFNVPjp3oABHqqU7wmlKFn0-_WH379fwCiJyX8LsHz5IhnKXBgG0hCrtQ5s/3ld/ZXXsi3YCTTigpb-_wyyJyA/h1/xRjVS79JKSDYdz8RyGk6bEISlutEVzBmJY2R_4sjeeg) The community that preceded the emergence of a cannabis industry is withering, as small and legacy growers find themselves squeezed by larger operations financed by corporate capital. Outrageously, some of that capital is coming from former corporate politicians like John Boehner, who built careers on the backs of incarcerated people, their families, and their communities, before now seeking profit from the very same activities they once criminalized. Beyond legalizing cannabis and protecting opportunities for small growers, I also hope to work in Congress to legalize psychedelics. While they offer a safe and effective treatment for many conditions and alternatives to less effective and more dangerous corporate pharmaceuticals, my vision for legalizing psychedelics goes beyond the medical setting to include recreational and spiritual uses. One reason it’s important to legalize mind-altering substances is to offer an alternative to the black market, where trade—and product safety—are effectively unregulated. San Francisco is reeling from a dramatic rise in overdoses, often suffered by people who didn’t realize that fentanyl had been added to what they thought was another substance. [**Our policy vision threatens the prison, policing, and pharmaceutical industries (in addition to those manufacturing fossil fuels and weapons). clean_body: We posted a video explaining the intersections between militarism and the war on drugs, noting in particular the groundbreaking revelations of the late journalist Gary Webb. | | | | | Dear Peter, **** April 20 is an annual holiday in many circles, particularly here in my neighborhood, Haight-Ashbury. It played a special role in the emergence of psychedelic counter-culture in the 1960s. And while the community has been dramatically gentrified in the years since then, it remains a beacon of the same ethos that drove so many to look beyond conventional wisdom. I’m grateful, among other things, for the acceptance of traditional plant medicines expanding so far beyond my neighborhood. While laws decriminalizing cannabis at the state level continue to sweep across the United States, a great deal of work remains to be done. Congress needs not only to legalize cannabis at the federal level to enable banking services and interstate commerce, but also to legislate limits on grow operations to preserve space for small and family farmers and growers. The community that preceded the emergence of a cannabis industry is withering, as small and legacy growers find themselves squeezed by larger operations financed by corporate capital. Outrageously, some of that capital is coming from former corporate politicians like John Boehner, who built careers on the backs of incarcerated people, their families, and their communities, before now seeking profit from the very same activities they once criminalized. Beyond legalizing cannabis and protecting opportunities for small growers, I also hope to work in Congress to legalize psychedelics. While they offer a safe and effective treatment for many conditions and alternatives to less effective and more dangerous corporate pharmaceuticals, my vision for legalizing psychedelics goes beyond the medical setting to include recreational and spiritual uses. One reason it’s important to legalize mind-altering substances is to offer an alternative to the black market, where trade—and product safety—are effectively unregulated. San Francisco is reeling from a dramatic rise in overdoses, often suffered by people who didn’t realize that fentanyl had been added to what they thought was another substance. Earlier today, we posted a short video (also available on , , , and ) explaining part of the forgotten history behind the war on drugs. In particular, I observe the CIA's role, documented by journalist Gary Webb in his groundbreaking book , and the implications of Webb's revelations in light of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.’s analysis of the three “intersecting evils” and Eisenhower’s parallel concerns about the military-industrial complex threatening democracy in America. the drug war will require more than criminal justice reform. And it will take more than electing District Attorneys critical of mass incarceration. Ending the war on drugs will require making better decisions on issues from criminal justice to judicial nominations and foreign policy. It will require policymakers willing to challenge militarism, and support the whistleblowers and publishers—from Daniel Ellsberg and Edward Snowden to Chelsea Manning, Reality Winner, and Julian Assange—who expose government secrets. I'm eager to serve you, our democracy, and the future in that role. Thank you for your support! It's your help that determines the strength and reach of our voice and the power of the alternative that we offer. Yours, Shahid PS — Not in a position to donate today? ! | | | | | | | | Dear Friends,

I recently sat down with Pat Dooris of KGW to discuss my comprehensive plan to tackle Oregon's homeless crisis. _**As someone who has actually been homeless, I know what needs to be done, because I've lived it.**_ We need to clean up our streets, provide accessible and comprehensive services for those in need, and finally address the root causes of homelessness: mental health issues and addiction.

To learn more about my plan, watch this 2-minute excerpt of my interview:

We need to clean up our streets, provide accessible and comprehensive services for those in need, and finally address the root causes of homelessness: mental health issues and addiction. To learn more about my plan, watch this 2-minute excerpt of my interview: | Watch an excerpt of my interview with KGW here! | If you're like me and want to know the finer details, click the link below to read more about my comprehensive plan to end unsheltered homelessness in Oregon. | "Read more" | It's high time we recognized that the status quo is failing us. We can't afford to elect more Salem politicians and expect any change. As a businesswoman, I'm not interested in politics -- I'm interested in results, and I know you are, too. Friends, I'm ready to make Oregon a national leader when it comes to proactive homeless solutions. Won't you join me? | | Sincerely, Jessica Gomez Republican for Governor | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2022 Jessica Gomez for Governor, All rights reserved.

| | **NEWS RELEASE**
Harbick for U.S. Senate
PO Box 2122
McKenzie Bridge, OR 97413

April 19, 2022

**Takes the lead in straw polls and fundraising**
**U.S. SENATE CANDIDATE HARBICK IS REPUBLICAN FRONTRUNNER**

**McKenzie Bridge, Ore. –** U.S. Senate candidate Darin Harbick has taken the lead among the six other Republican candidates running in the Oregon primary election scheduled May 17.

Harbick is leading his Republican competition on two fronts – public opinion polls and fundraising.

One straw poll, conducted by Northwest Observer, shows Harbick leading by more votes than his competition combined having more than 63 percent of the vote. The Northwest Observer is an online news website at [northwestobserver.com](https://harbickforussenate.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3dd8e7fd3b4e92c0bcc1988f&id=53288c474b&e=97f786938b). A straw poll is an unofficial ballot that is taken to discover how people intend to vote in an election.

Another straw poll, conducted by Benton County GOP Central Committee, shows Harbick ahead of all his competition after a candidates’ debate in Corvallis on March 31. Harbick walked away as the preferred candidate among voting members of the audience, receiving 33 ballots out of 40 total over three rounds of voting.

“While these straw polls are not scientific surveys and don’t illustrate a representative sample, it does clearly identify Darin has the support of a majority of GOP primary voters,” said Harbick’s campaign manager Bruce Starr.

In taking the lead in the straw polls Harbick has the momentum to win the race to represent the Republican Party and face off against Democratic incumbent U.S. Sen. Ron Wyden in November, according to Starr.

Starr pointed out that Harbick has received more campaign financial contributions than his Republican competitors.

“Darin has raised more than three times the amount of money of all his primary opponents combined by the end of the first quarter,” Starr said. “In addition, he has more than five times the amount of his closest competitor.”

Harbick’s total contributions come to $265, 692 with $66,317 cash on hand. Sam Palmer’s total is $65,084 with $10,788 cash on hand. Jo Rae Perkins total is $21,809 with $14,110 cash on hand. Jason Beebe’s total is $12,774 with $4,814.37 cash on hand. And Ibra Taher’s total is $6,263, with $0 cash on hand. All contributions stated are as of March 31. Two candidates, Chris Christensen and Robert Fleming, reported no political contributions.

“Given the success Harbick has garnered so far, in terms of campaign contributions and opinion polls, he definitely is the probable candidate who will face Sen. Wyden in the general election,” Starr said.

Harbick said his strong lead and public support reflects what he is hearing on the campaign trail.

"I am grateful to Oregonians who have rallied around my campaign message of fighting inflation, securing the border, properly managing our forests and public lands, and ending the extraordinary federal government overreach and spending,” Harbick said. “Oregonians want a clear choice between the status quo and a new path for Oregon in November," he added.

Voters in Oregon will elect one member to the U.S. Senate in the general election on Nov. 8, 2022. The primary is scheduled for May 17 next month. The election will fill the Senate seat held by Ron Wyden (D), who first took office in 1996.

For details about Harbick and his platform, public events and endorsements, visit online at [harbickforUSSenate.com](https://harbickforussenate.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3dd8e7fd3b4e92c0bcc1988f&id=35a10697ab&e=97f786938b).

**About Darin Harbick**
Darin Harbick, 53, was born in Springfield, Ore. and lives in Rainbow, Ore. Harbick graduated from McKenzie High School. His career experience includes working in management at a national-chain grocery store; owning and managing restaurants, a grocery store and motel; establishing a state-licensed, faith-based mental care treatment facility in Rainbow; and starting a logging and hauling business. Harbick has served on the McKenzie School District Board of Directors, McKenzie Chamber of Commerce, and Travel Lane County tourism board. He has also coached women’s’ basketball teams at the middle school, high school and college levels. Harbick and his wife Kail have three adult children and two grandsons. For information about Harbick and his platform, public events and endorsements, visit online at [harbickforUSSenate.com](https://harbickforussenate.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3dd8e7fd3b4e92c0bcc1988f&id=c1dad4289c&e=97f786938b).
