clean_body: This is what it’ll take to face off against a multi-millionaire Republican. | | | Peter, From day one, this has been a campaign by and for the working people of Tennessee. We’re up against a multi-millionaire Republican, Mark Green, who’s been funding his campaign with money from corporate PACs and pro-insurrection representatives like Jim Jordan. His average contribution last fundraising quarter was $224.66. Ours was just $37.68. I know our greatest strength is that we’re a movement of working people coming together to shake up the status quo. I’m proud that our average contribution is so much lower than Mark Green’s — it means that our organizing efforts are powered by everyday people who truly believe in this message. It means that when I get to Capitol Hill, I’ll be truly accountable to the people, not corporate donors. But funding our campaign this way also means that we depend heavily on our grassroots supporters. For every $1,000 check Mark Green gets from a corporate PAC (and he got more than a few in the past couple of months) we need 27 folks to give our average contribution of $37.68 to keep up. Even if you’re unable to make a contribution right now, thank you for reading messages like this from me — it really counts. Thank you, good people! Odessa Kelly | To give by check: Odessa for Congress 2817 West End Ave, Ste 126-401 Nashville, TN 37203

Dear Peter,
Over the past several months, I’ve had an incredible time meeting Marylanders where they are: at parks and parades, cafes and coffee shops, local small businesses, and neighborhood main streets. If I haven’t had a chance to meet you in person yet, then I’m delighted to invite you to our upcoming Campaign Rally in Fort Washington on April 23.
Our family-friendly rally will feature food, drink, music, and special guests from around the state. The event is free, so be sure to bring your friends, family, and children!
https://secure.ngpvan.com/ppo_YoIYkUKqmayznTxtXA2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/ppo_YoIYkUKqmayznTxtXA2]
As the Local Candidate for Governor, the people of Maryland know me, and I know them. Thanks to the incredible activists, allies, volunteers, and friends powering this movement from the grassroots up, our campaign continues to gain momentum as we enter the final stretch of this exciting primary race. We’re leading in the polls by a strong margin, and we have more endorsements from current and former elected officials than any other candidate in this race.
The enthusiasm we’ve been witnessing on the campaign trail is a true testament to the growing strength of our people-powered movement, and I hope you can join us on April 23 to witness it for yourself and speak to me about the kitchen-table issues. Together, we’re going to deliver on the concrete points of progress to lift Marylanders into the high quality of life that they deserve in the years to come.
Our April 23 Campaign Rally will be held at the Tucker Road Athletic Complex in Fort Washington, from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM. Click here to RSVP. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/ppo_YoIYkUKqmayznTxtXA2]

Peter,

Like so many Americans, I watched the scenes of Afghanistan's fall with disbelief, extreme sadness and even anger. You see, I served the greatest country on Earth in Afghanistan back in 2015. But Afghanistan wasn't the only place I looked terrorism directly in the eyes...

**August 21 st 2021 marked six years since the fateful late-summer afternoon that changed my life and those of my two best friends - forever.**

**I had just finished serving our great nation in Afghanistan when my best friends and I decided to take a vacation in Europe**. We were traveling on a Paris-bound train when a terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill us all.

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat -As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. **Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.**

This split-second decision prevented what witnesses contend could have become a mass slaughter. body:
| | | |
---
| | | Dear friend,
---
## Biden is opening the floodgates at the southern border
This is complete insanity by our government, but it's become clear: the Biden administration is attempting to bring in as many illegal immigrants as possible. Since the beginning of the administration, Biden has been loosening the restrictions on immigration at our border, dismantling our security systems, and taking all enforcement tools away from our Border Patrol. But nothing will compare to the lifting of Title 42. It was the last policy keeping any restriction on our border, **and the DHS is estimating up to 18,000 illegals may cross every day.** Biden and the Democrats aren't the only ones to blame. RINOs like Jaime Herrera Beutler are as well.
**[STOP THE ESTABLISHMENT](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/bSB2I4VbLOSZQ1X3j7Vo763g/bSB2I4VbLOSZQ1X3j7Vo763g)**
President Trump was building the wall. And if he finished it, we wouldn't have this problem on our hands today. **But swamp monsters like Jaime Herrera Beutler voted to halt construction of the wall.** And now we're paying for it. Violent crime, illegal immigration, fetanyl flooding in, as well as the replacement of working class jobs that should be reserved for Americans.
**[END THE BORDER CRISIS](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/bSB2I4VbLOSZQ1X3j7Vo763g/bSB2I4VbLOSZQ1X3j7Vo763g)**
Our country has suffered the effects of illegal immigration for too long, with no help from the establishment. I will not stand by while our country enables and encourages a hostile foreign invasion of our territory. It's time for America First conservatives to take our country back and STOP the flood of immigrants crossing our border. Thank you for your support, patriot. Joe Kent

[](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Yx19vcy2GfgdHSjblFdMQA/bSB2I4VbLOSZQ1X3j7Vo763g)
### UPCOMING EVENTS

Please share a photo of us on social media and use the hashtag #JOEKENTFORCONGRESS

Fellow American,

I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called _The Nation_ before last week. Now, I'll never forget it.

They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece.

There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this:

"Herschel Walker, the football star turned Georgia Senate candidate, is an animated caricature of a Black person drawn by white conservatives."
Or maybe this line:

"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."
It's shameful.

But the writer doesn't just take aim at me. He questions the support from folks like you, too:

"Most white people in the South vote 'R' like their entire white supremacist project depends on it."
Fellow American, I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign. However, can you imagine the reaction from the mainstream media if these things had been said about a Black Democrat? The outrage! There would be calls for the writer to be fired and the publication cancelled.

But I'm not calling for a protest of the author or a boycott of the publication's advertisers. Nothing like that.

_**I think the best answer is to prove them wrong at the ballot box.**_

When I get to Congress, I plan to continue the work of driving investment in technology in St. Louis. Can you help me win this race so I can follow through? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2204-q2-bs-innovation?refcode=220420-email]

Our city has so much potential, but we need to elect people who see that and are also willing to fight to make that potential a reality.
Please chip in whatever you can. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2204-q2-bs-innovation?refcode=220420-email]

| | |
# **_Stop Biden and Pelosi's Anti-Rights Agenda_**
#
Like many of you last week, I watched Joe Biden's bizarre antics in the Rose Garden while he babbled about taking away your right to protect yourselves and your family--arguably the only policy he's actually been consistent on his entire career.

It was an upsetting display by a national leadership class that clearly no longer cares about either public safety nor the rights they are sworn to uphold.

[Click here to watch my new video on the Second Amendment.](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=40c3984771&e=d32193ab14)

The fact of the matter is Biden, Pelosi and their cronies continue to support the release of violent criminals and the mentally ill on our streets; while at the same time attacking your rights by ramming new gun control bills through congress and by executive fiat.

I can tell you as a Law Enforcement Officer with 32 years of experience this is a toxic combination that will only result in higher crime and more tragedies.

Ironically, Biden and those around him have arguably been responsible for the proliferation of more black market weaponry than anyone in history. With deadly operations like the Fast and Furious gun running scandal--and--the abandonment of over 500,000 firearms and other weaponry to terrorists in Afghanistan, it's astonishing they still have the audacity to blame normal Americans like you for any kind of gun crime.

# "Shall Not Be Infringed"
#
If elected to congress I will stand with you and fight to protect your Constitutional Rights.

Our founders didn’t write the Second Amendment just to mean we’d be able to hunt and protect our family from a burglar or robber. That was a given.

The Second Amendment was specifically written to keep an overbearing government from being able to disarm us and impose its will on the citizenry.

Our founders had some experience with this, which is why this is the only right in the Constitution which states, “shall not be infringed.”

There’s no ambiguity there.

The Second Amendment, like the Constitution as a whole, is unique in history. Never has another government recognized the right of the populace to defend itself against all enemies, foreign, or domestic.

Self-defense – from anyone or anything – is a guaranteed protection in the USA.

## Kendall Qualls Supports Governor's Emergency Powers
### Wednesday April 20th, 2022
Friend, It's obvious to us that the Democrat politicians have no issue with the status quo on Unilateral Emergency Powers. They protected Governor Walz' lockdowns and mandates for a year and a half. And they'll do it all over again! **But prominent, insider Republicans are also showing us their true colors on this issue. Some of them are on board with keeping the Governor's Unilateral Emergency Powers like Gubernatorial Candidate Kendall Qualls.** Just the other day, Qualls trashed the Never Again Bill at a GOP debate while saying that he thinks a Governor should be able to self-declare emergency powers for 30 days. [WATCH THE VIDEO!](https://www.action4liberty.com/qualls_supports_emergency_powers?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=qualls_opposes_never_again&n=2) [](https://www.action4liberty.com/qualls_supports_emergency_powers?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=qualls_opposes_never_again&n=3) Are you kidding me? The Constitution does not allow a Governor to be King. Qualls thinks the Constitution can be suspended for 30 days. That's crazy! I don't care if it's a **Walz lockdown or a Qualls lockdown** \- we can't afford to allow a Governor to trample on our rights for even one day! How are we going to Stop Mandates and Emergency Powers if we can't even get Republicans on board? I'm sick of these insiders who keep fighting us on the most important issue of our time. We have a policy agenda, they have a power agenda. He says he swore an oath to the Constitution. Well then prove it! **Call and text Kendall Qualls and tell him to reconsider his stance. Tell him to stand up for our Constitution and our liberties. Tell him to SIGN the Never Again Pledge today!** **Phone: 763-402-6182** **Email: kqualls1981@gmail.com**

Peter, the war on marijuana has gone on for far too long.

The strict enforcement of marijuana laws has done nothing but harm our communities – especially communities of color. While white and Black people use marijuana at roughly the same rate, Black people are nearly **_4 times_** more likely to be arrested for possession.

**The overpolicing of marijuana use, especially in Black and brown communities, is a _crisis_ that has destroyed the lives of too many.** _No one_ should be penalized for a substance that's been legalized in 18 states and counting – but people of color continue to be punished disproportionately.

| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

## Whitmer and Nessel Use Racial Politics to Inflame and Divide
#### by Captain Michael Brown
---
|
---
| Before the investigation is even done, Governor Whitmer and her radical liberal allies are seeking to further inflame and divide our communities. They’ve asked Joe Biden’s Department of Justice to intervene pushing for an investigation of potential civil rights violations in the officer-involved shooting of Patrick Lyoya.

It’s a baseless request with zero evidence. It will do nothing more than further inflame an already difficult situation.

This should come as no surprise. Whitmer and Attorney General Nessel stand against law enforcement. They would rather put a target on the backs of our police officers than address the real problem — a dramatic increase in violent crime in Grand Rapids and other communities in Michigan.

In just the last year, violent crimes including shootings, attempted murder, assault with firearms, and assault with firearms with injuries are all up in Grand Rapids. The number of illegal guns seized is also up more than 17% over the previous year.

Law enforcement officers, in Michigan and throughout the nation, have an increasingly difficult job. As radical politicians like Whitmer and Nessel point fingers and side with the “defund the police” crowd, they encourage the public to be antagonistic to the police.

We see more and more individuals openly defy lawful orders from police officers who are simply trying to do their jobs in the safest manner possible.

Quite frankly, our officers risk their lives every day to protect the citizens of Michigan. During a routine traffic stop, domestic violence call, or store burglary, police arrive on the scene without foreknowledge of the potential threats that may await them.

Oftentimes this requires officers to make split-second decisions. That’s where their training comes into play.

During my 34 year career in law enforcement, I have been a strong advocate for effective training, as well as for the use of body cams to protect both our officers and the public during all interactions. The goal is to keep the public safe, and to return officers safely to their homes.

Whitmer, Nessel and their radical allies need to stop demonizing the police. Let the investigation by the Kent County Prosecutor and Michigan State Police continue without interference so that justice may be done.
